It is important for everyone, including management and the general workforce, to understand that threats and vulnerabilities change constantly, and that regular refresher training is an important part of security awareness.
texts.text: People tend to think that security awareness training can be completed once and:it is good forever. It is important for everyone, including management and the general workforce, to understand that threats and vulnerabilities change constantly, and that regular refresher training is an important part of security awareness.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 108. Which of the following do security policies need to be MOST closely aligned with?
texts.text: Which of the following do security policies need to be MOST closely aligned with?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Industry good practices
texts.text: Industry good practices

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Organizational needs
texts.text: Organizational needs

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Generally accepted standards
texts.text: Generally accepted standards

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Local laws and regulations
texts.text: Local laws and regulations

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Good practices are generally a substitute for a clear understanding of what exactly is needed in a specific enterprise and may be too much or too little.
texts.text: Good practices are generally a substitute for a clear understanding of what exactly is needed in a specific enterprise and may be too much or too little.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Policies must support the needs of the enterprise.
texts.text: Policies must support the needs of the enterprise.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Local law and regulation compliance may be identified in policies but would only be a small part of overall policies that must support the needs of the enterprise.
texts.text: Local law and regulation compliance may be identified in policies but would only be a small part of overall policies that must support the needs of the enterprise.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Generally accepted standards do not exist; they are always tailored to the requirements of the enterprise.
texts.text: Generally accepted standards do not exist; they are always tailored to the requirements of the enterprise.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 109. What is the BEST way to determine if an anomaly-based intrusion detection system (IDS) is properly installed?
texts.text: What is the BEST way to determine if an anomaly-based intrusion detection system (IDS) is properly installed?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Simulate an attack and review IDS performance.
texts.text: Simulate an attack and review IDS performance.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Use a honeypot to check for unusual activity.
texts.text: Use a honeypot to check for unusual activity.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Audit the configuration of the IDS.
texts.text: Audit the configuration of the IDS.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Benchmark the IDS against a peer site.
texts.text: Benchmark the IDS against a peer site.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Simulating an attack on the network demonstrates whether the intrusion detection system (IDS) is properly tuned.
texts.text: Simulating an attack on the network demonstrates whether the intrusion detection system (IDS) is properly tuned.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. A honeypot would be a poor test to see if the IDS is working properly because attacking it is discretionary and not representative of all attacks.
texts.text: A honeypot would be a poor test to see if the IDS is working properly because attacking it is discretionary and not representative of all attacks.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Reviewing the configuration may or may not reveal weaknesses because an anomaly-based system uses trends to identify potential attacks.
texts.text: Reviewing the configuration may or may not reveal weaknesses because an anomaly-based system uses trends to identify potential attacks.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Benchmarking against a peer site would generally not be practical or useful.
texts.text: Benchmarking against a peer site would generally not be practical or useful.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 110. When is the BEST time to perform a penetration test?
texts.text: When is the BEST time to perform a penetration test?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. After an attempted penetration has occurred
texts.text: After an attempted penetration has occurred

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. After an audit has reported weaknesses in security controls
texts.text: After an audit has reported weaknesses in security controls

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. After various infrastructure changes are made
texts.text: After various infrastructure changes are made

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. After a high turnover in systems staff
texts.text: After a high turnover in systems staff

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Conducting a test after an attempted penetration is not as productive because an enterprise should not wait until it is attacked to test its defenses.
texts.text: Conducting a test after an attempted penetration is not as productive because an enterprise should not wait until it is attacked to test its defenses.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Any exposure identified by an audit should be corrected before it would be appropriate to test.
texts.text: Any exposure identified by an audit should be corrected before it would be appropriate to test.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A turnover in administrative staff does not warrant a penetration test, although it may warrant a review of password change practices and configuration management.
texts.text: A turnover in administrative staff does not warrant a penetration test, although it may warrant a review of password change practices and configuration management.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Changes in the systems infrastructure are most likely to inadvertently introduce new exposures.
texts.text: Changes in the systems infrastructure are most likely to inadvertently introduce new exposures.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 111. Which of the following project activities is the MAIN activity in developing an information security program?
texts.text: Which of the following project activities is the MAIN activity in developing an information security program?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Security organization development
texts.text: Security organization development

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Conceptual and logical architecture designs
texts.text: Conceptual and logical architecture designs

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Development of risk management objectives
texts.text: Development of risk management objectives

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Control design and deployment
texts.text: Control design and deployment

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The security organization is developed to meet the needs of the security program and may evolve over time, based on evolving requirements.
texts.text: The security organization is developed to meet the needs of the security program and may evolve over time, based on evolving requirements.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Conceptual and logical architecture designs should have been completed as a part of strategy and road map development.
texts.text: Conceptual and logical architecture designs should have been completed as a part of strategy and road map development.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Risk management objectives are a part of strategy development.
texts.text: Risk management objectives are a part of strategy development.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The majority of program development activities will involve designing, testing and deploying controls that achieve the risk management objectives.
texts.text: The majority of program development activities will involve designing, testing and deploying controls that achieve the risk management objectives.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 112. Which of the following is the BEST way to detect an intruder who successfully penetrates a network before significant damage is inflicted?
texts.text: Which of the following is the BEST way to detect an intruder who successfully penetrates a network before significant damage is inflicted?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Perform periodic penetration testing
texts.text: Perform periodic penetration testing

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Establish minimum security baselines
texts.text: Establish minimum security baselines

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Implement vendor default settings
texts.text: Implement vendor default settings

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Install a honeypot on the network
texts.text: Install a honeypot on the network

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Penetration testing will not detect an intruder.
texts.text: Penetration testing will not detect an intruder.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Security baselines set minimum security levels but are not related to detecting intruders.
texts.text: Security baselines set minimum security levels but are not related to detecting intruders.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Implementing vendor default settings do not detect intruders and this approach is not the best idea.
texts.text: Implementing vendor default settings do not detect intruders and this approach is not the best idea.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Honeypots attract hackers away from sensitive systems and files. Because honeypots are closely monitored, the intrusion is more likely to be detected before significant damage is inflicted.
texts.text: Honeypots attract hackers away from sensitive systems and files. Because honeypots are closely monitored, the intrusion is more likely to be detected before significant damage is inflicted.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 113. If a security .incident is not the result of the failure of acontrol, then it is:MOST likely the result of which of the following choices?
texts.text: If a security .incident is not the result of the failure of acontrol, then it is:MOST likely the result of which of the following choices?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. An incomplete risk analysis
texts.text: An incomplete risk analysis

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The absence of a control
texts.text: The absence of a control

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A zero-day attack
texts.text: A zero-day attack

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A user error
texts.text: A user error

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. An incomplete risk analysis may have the effect of a suitable control not being implemented, but it is not the reason that a compromise occurs.
texts.text: An incomplete risk analysis may have the effect of a suitable control not being implemented, but it is not the reason that a compromise occurs.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. A security incident is inevitably the result of a control failure or the lack of a suitable control.
texts.text: A security incident is inevitably the result of a control failure or the lack of a suitable control.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A user error will only result in a security incident because of control failure or the absence of a control.
texts.text: A user error will only result in a security incident because of control failure or the absence of a control.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A zero-day attack is difficult to predict, but it will only be successful if a control fails or does not exist.
texts.text: A zero-day attack is difficult to predict, but it will only be successful if a control fails or does not exist.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 114. In a social engineering scenario, which of the following will MOST likely reduce the likelihood of an unauthorized individual gaining access to computing resources?
texts.text: In a social engineering scenario, which of the following will MOST likely reduce the likelihood of an unauthorized individual gaining access to computing resources?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Implementing on-screen masking of passwords
texts.text: Implementing on-screen masking of passwords

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Conducting periodic security awareness programs
texts.text: Conducting periodic security awareness programs

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Increasing the frequency of password changes
texts.text: Increasing the frequency of password changes

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Requiring that passwords be kept strictly confidential
texts.text: Requiring that passwords be kept strictly confidential

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Implementing on-screen masking of passwords is desirable but will not be effective in reducing the likelihood of a successful social engineering attack.
texts.text: Implementing on-screen masking of passwords is desirable but will not be effective in reducing the likelihood of a successful social engineering attack.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Social engineering can best be mitigated through periodic security awareness training for users who may be the target of such an attempt.
texts.text: Social engineering can best be mitigated through periodic security awareness training for users who may be the target of such an attempt.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Increasing the frequency of password changes is desirable but will not be effective in reducing the likelihood of a successful social engineering attack.
texts.text: Increasing the frequency of password changes is desirable but will not be effective in reducing the likelihood of a successful social engineering attack.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Requiring that passwords be kept secret in security policies is a good control but is not as effective as periodic security awareness programs that will aleit users of the dangers posed by social engineering.
texts.text: Requiring that passwords be kept secret in security policies is a good control but is not as effective as periodic security awareness programs that will aleit users of the dangers posed by social engineering.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 115. Assuming all options are technically feasible, which of the following would be the MOST effective approach for the information security manager to address excessive exposure of a critical customer-facing server?
texts.text: Assuming all options are technically feasible, which of the following would be the MOST effective approach for the information security manager to address excessive exposure of a critical customer-facing server?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Develop an incident response plan
texts.text: Develop an incident response plan

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Reduce the attack vectors
texts.text: Reduce the attack vectors

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Initiate compartmentalization
texts.text: Initiate compartmentalization

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Implement compensating controls
texts.text: Implement compensating controls

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Even the most effective incident response plan is unlikely to reduce exposure as effectively as reducing the attack surface.
texts.text: Even the most effective incident response plan is unlikely to reduce exposure as effectively as reducing the attack surface.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The attack vectors determine the extent of exposure. Reducing the attack.vectors by limiting entry points, ports and protocols and taking other precautions reduces the exposure.
texts.text: The attack vectors determine the extent of exposure. Reducing the attack.vectors by limiting entry points, ports and protocols and taking other precautions reduces the exposure.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Compartmentalization may limit the degree to which impact sustained by one customer results in increased vulnerability or impact for another customer, but the per-customer exposure would not be affected.
texts.text: Compartmentalization may limit the degree to which impact sustained by one customer results in increased vulnerability or impact for another customer, but the per-customer exposure would not be affected.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Compensating controls are appropriate if existing controls are incapable of reducing risk to acceptable levels.
texts.text: Compensating controls are appropriate if existing controls are incapable of reducing risk to acceptable levels.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 116. Which of the following is the MOST appropriate individual to implement and maintain the level of information security needed for a specific business application?
texts.text: Which of the following is the MOST appropriate individual to implement and maintain the level of information security needed for a specific business application?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. System analyst
texts.text: System analyst

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Quality control manager
texts.text: Quality control manager

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Process owner
texts.text: Process owner

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.text: The system analyst does not possess the necessary knowledge or authority to implement and maintain the appropriate level of business security.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Quality control managers do not implement security.
texts.text: Quality control managers do not implement security.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Process owners implement information protection controls as determined by the business' needs. Process owners have the most knowledge about security requirements for the business application for which they are responsible.
texts.text: Process owners implement information protection controls as determined by the business' needs. Process owners have the most knowledge about security requirements for the business application for which they are responsible.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The information security manager will implement the information security framework and develop standards and controls, but the level of security required by a specific business application is determined by the process owner.
texts.text: The information security manager will implement the information security framework and develop standards and controls, but the level of security required by a specific business application is determined by the process owner.

texts.orig: B. Discretionary

texts.text: A walled garden is an environment that controls a user's access to web content and services, In effect, the walled garden directs the user's navigation within particular areas and does not necessarily prevent sharing of other material.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Role-based access controls grant access according to the role assigned to a user; they do not prevent file sharing with unauthorized users.
texts.text: Role-based access controls grant access according to the role assigned to a user; they do not prevent file sharing with unauthorized users.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 129. Which of the following is the BEST way to ensure that a corporate network is adequately secured against external attack?
texts.text: Which of the following is the BEST way to ensure that a corporate network is adequately secured against external attack?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Use an intrusion detection system.
texts.text: Use an intrusion detection system.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Implement vendor-recommended settings.
texts.text: Implement vendor-recommended settings.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Establish minimum security baselines.
texts.text: Establish minimum security baselines.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Perform periodic penetration testing.
texts.text: Perform periodic penetration testing.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. An intrusion detection system may detect an attempted attack, but it will not confirm whether the perimeter is secure.

texts.orig: C. Vendor-recommended settings may be used to harden systems but provide little assurance that other vulnerabilities do not exist, which may be exposéd by penetration testing.

texts.orig: 130. Which of the following presents the GREATEST exposure to internal attack on a network?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. User passwords are not automatically expired.
texts.text: User passwords are not automatically expired.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. All network traffic goes through a single switch.
texts.text: All network traffic goes through a single switch.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. User passwords are encoded but not encrypted.
texts.text: User passwords are encoded but not encrypted.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. All users reside on a single internal subnet.
texts.text: All users reside on a single internal subnet.

texts.label: section_header

texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Not setting user passwords to automatically expire does create an exposure but not as great as having unencrypted passwords.
texts.text: Not setting user passwords to automatically expire does create an exposure but not as great as having unencrypted passwords.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Using a single switch does not present a significant exposure.
texts.text: Using a single switch does not present a significant exposure.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Using a subnet does not present a significant exposure.
texts.text: Using a subnet does not present a significant exposure.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. When passwords are sent over the internal network in an encoded format, they can easily be converted to cleartext. All passwords should be encrypted to provide adequate security.
texts.text: When passwords are sent over the internal network in an encoded format, they can easily be converted to cleartext. All passwords should be encrypted to provide adequate security.

texts.orig: 131. Outsourcing combined with indemnification:
texts.text: 131. Outsourcing combined with indemnification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. reduces legal responsibility but leaves financial risk relatively unchanged.
texts.text: reduces legal responsibility but leaves financial risk relatively unchanged.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. is more cost-effective as a means of risk transfer than purchasing insurance.
texts.text: is more cost-effective as a means of risk transfer than purchasing insurance.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. eliminates the reputational risk present when operations remain in-house.
texts.text: eliminates the reputational risk present when operations remain in-house.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. reduces financial risk but leaves legal responsibility generally unchanged.
texts.text: reduces financial risk but leaves legal responsibility generally unchanged.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Although indemnification clauses are intended to deflect liability, the legal consequences associated with compromises in information security cannot be fully transferred.
texts.text: Although indemnification clauses are intended to deflect liability, the legal consequences associated with compromises in information security cannot be fully transferred.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The cost-effectiveness of various forms of risk transfer depends on many factors, such as the scope of operations, limits of liability, specialized knowledge that may be required for implementation and criteria for indemnification.
texts.text: The cost-effectiveness of various forms of risk transfer depends on many factors, such as the scope of operations, limits of liability, specialized knowledge that may be required for implementation and criteria for indemnification.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Clients deal directly with the enterprise, not its supply chain. Outsourcing generally has no effect on reputational risk, which remains associated with the enterprise's own brand regardless of outsourcing arrangements or indemnification clauses.
texts.text: Clients deal directly with the enterprise, not its supply chain. Outsourcing generally has no effect on reputational risk, which remains associated with the enterprise's own brand regardless of outsourcing arrangements or indemnification clauses.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Indemnification clauses can transfer operational risk and financial impacts associated with that risk; however, legal responsibility for the consequences of compromise generally remains with the original entity.
texts.text: Indemnification clauses can transfer operational risk and financial impacts associated with that risk; however, legal responsibility for the consequences of compromise generally remains with the original entity.

texts.text: risk avoidance is justified by cost-benefit analysis.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Compliance requirements defined in the information security policy

texts.orig: 136. Which of the following choices is the MOST significant single point of failure in a public key infrastructure?
texts.text: Which of the following choices is the MOST significant single point of failure in a public key infrastructure?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A certificate authority's (CA) public key
texts.text: A certificate authority's (CA) public key

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. A relying party's private key
texts.text: A relying party's private key

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A CA's private key
texts.text: A CA's private key

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A relying party's public key
texts.text: A relying party's public key

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The certificate authority's (CA) public key is published and poses no risk.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: If destroyed, lost or compromised, the private key of any relying party affects only that party.

texts.text: The public key is published and poses no risk.

texts.text: What is the PRIMARY reason for using metrics to evaluate information security?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. To identify security weaknesses
texts.text: To identify security weaknesses

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. To justify budgetary expenditures
texts.text: To justify budgetary expenditures

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. To enable steady improvement
texts.text: To enable steady improvement

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. To raise awareness of security issues
texts.text: To raise awareness of security issues

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Metrics may not identify vulnerabilities.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 138. What is the BEST method to confirm that all firewall rules and router configuration settings are adequate?
texts.text: What is the BEST method to confirm that all firewall rules and router configuration settings are adequate?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Periodic review of network configuration
texts.text: Periodic review of network configuration

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Review of intrusion detection system logs for evidence of attacks
texts.text: Review of intrusion detection system logs for evidence of attacks

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Periodically perform penetration tests
texts.text: Periodically perform penetration tests

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Daily review of server logs for evidence of hacker activity
texts.text: Daily review of server logs for evidence of hacker activity

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Due to the complexity of firewall rules and router tables, plus the sheer size of intrusion detection systems (IDSs) and server logs, a physical review would be complex, time-consuming and probably insufficient.
texts.text: Due to the complexity of firewall rules and router tables, plus the sheer size of intrusion detection systems (IDSs) and server logs, a physical review would be complex, time-consuming and probably insufficient.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Reviewing IDS logs for evidence of attacks would not indicate whether the settings were adequate.
texts.text: Reviewing IDS logs for evidence of attacks would not indicate whether the settings were adequate.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The best approach for confirming the adequacy of these configuration settings is to periodically perform attack and penetration tests.
texts.text: The best approach for confirming the adequacy of these configuration settings is to periodically perform attack and penetration tests.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Evidence of hacker activity has little to do with configuration adequacy.
texts.text: Evidence of hacker activity has little to do with configuration adequacy.

texts.text: Increased interest in focus groups on security issues

texts.orig: 141. Which of the following will BEST prevent an employee from using a universal serial bus (USB) drive to copy files from desktop computers?
texts.text: Which of the following will BEST prevent an employee from using a universal serial bus (USB) drive to copy files from desktop computers?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Restrict the available drive allocation on all personal computers.
texts.text: Restrict the available drive allocation on all personal computers.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Disable USB ports on all desktop devices.
texts.text: Disable USB ports on all desktop devices.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Conduct frequent awareness training with noncompliance penalties.
texts.text: Conduct frequent awareness training with noncompliance penalties.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Establish strict access controls to sensitive information.
texts.text: Establish strict access controls to sensitive information.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Restricting the ability of a personal computer to allocate new drive letters ensures that universal serial bus (USB) drives or even compact disc-writers cannot be attached because they would not be recognized by the operating system.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Disabling USB ports on all machines is not practical because mice and other peripherals depend on these connections.
texts.text: Disabling USB ports on all machines is not practical because mice and other peripherals depend on these connections.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Awareness training does not prevent copying of information.
texts.text: Awareness training does not prevent copying of information.

texts.text: Access controls do not prevent copying.

texts.orig: A. prevent an increase in audit findings.
texts.text: prevent an increase in audit findings.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. address changes in exposure.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. avoid a substantial increase in cost.
texts.text: avoid a substantial increase in cost.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: maintain alignment with regulatory requirements.

texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item

texts.orig: C. Gap analysis does not necessarily avoid increases in cost.

texts.text: Remove all trading partner access until the situation improves.

texts.text: Set up firewall rules restricting network traffic from that location.

texts.text: What is the MOST appropriate change management procedure for the handling of emergency program changes?

texts.text: Business management approval must be obtained prior to the change.

texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Formal documentation is still required as soon as possible after the emergency changes have been implemented.
texts.text: Formal documentation is still required as soon as possible after the emergency changes have been implemented.

texts.orig: 147. Which of the following poses the GREATEST challenge to an enterprise seeking to prioritize risk management activities?
texts.text: Which of the following poses the GREATEST challenge to an enterprise seeking to prioritize risk management activities?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. An incomplete catalog of information assets
texts.text: An incomplete catalog of information assets

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. A threat assessment that is not comprehensive
texts.text: A threat assessment that is not comprehensive

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A vulnerability assessment that is outdated
texts.text: A vulnerability assessment that is outdated

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. An inaccurate valuation of information assets
texts.text: An inaccurate valuation of information assets

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Enterprises are only able to prioritize items they know to exist. An incomplete catalog of information assets introduces the possibility that prioritization is overlooking assets that may have substantial value, unintentionally resulting in the implicit acceptance of risk that may exceed the risk appetite and tolerance. However, inaccurate valuation of known assets has a greater negative impact on prioritization than the possibility of certain high-value assets not being properly taken into account.
texts.text: Enterprises are only able to prioritize items they know to exist. An incomplete catalog of information assets introduces the possibility that prioritization is overlooking assets that may have substantial value, unintentionally resulting in the implicit acceptance of risk that may exceed the risk appetite and tolerance. However, inaccurate valuation of known assets has a greater negative impact on prioritization than the possibility of certain high-value assets not being properly taken into account.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. It is common for a vulnerability assessment to be outdated at the start of each cycle of a risk management program prior to the start of risk management activities, but the influence of outdated vulnerability information is less a concern than inaccurate valuation of assets.
texts.text: It is common for a vulnerability assessment to be outdated at the start of each cycle of a risk management program prior to the start of risk management activities, but the influence of outdated vulnerability information is less a concern than inaccurate valuation of assets.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Evaluating the threat environment is the most challenging aspect of risk assessment, and it is nearly always the case that a threat assessment excludes one or more threats. As a result, any prioritization effort must assume that the threat assessment is not comprehensive.
texts.text: Evaluating the threat environment is the most challenging aspect of risk assessment, and it is nearly always the case that a threat assessment excludes one or more threats. As a result, any prioritization effort must assume that the threat assessment is not comprehensive.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Although prioritization on the basis of risk requires knowledge of threat, vulnerability and potential consequence, it is this last factor expressed in terms of value that is most influential when prioritizing risk management activities. If assets are valued incorrectly, otherwise justifiable decisions of how to prioritize activities may be incorrect.
texts.text: Although prioritization on the basis of risk requires knowledge of threat, vulnerability and potential consequence, it is this last factor expressed in terms of value that is most influential when prioritizing risk management activities. If assets are valued incorrectly, otherwise justifiable decisions of how to prioritize activities may be incorrect.

texts.orig: A. Probability of fire

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Cost of maintenance

texts.text: Justification:

texts.text: Probability is part of the justification for adopting an automated fire suppression system, but which system is most appropriate depends on other factors.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The cost of maintenance is:an important consideration, but because damage is likely to be much more costly than maintenance, it is a later consideration.
texts.text: The cost of maintenance is:an important consideration, but because damage is likely to be much more costly than maintenance, it is a later consideration.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Fire suppression systems may be harmful to resources; therefore, automated systems that release gas or water automatically have their own pros and cons. Gas-based systems are harimful to human life, whereas water-based systems may damage IT resources. Hence, the selection and implementation must consider these aspects,

texts.orig: D. Ownership of assets, including the new system to be acquired, is required to determine the protection levels of resources. texts.text: A critical device is delivered with a single user ID and password that is required to be shared for multiple users to access the device. An information security manager has been tasked with ensuring all access to the device is authorized. Which of the following would be the MOST efficient means to accomplish this?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Enable access through a separate device that requires adequate authentication
texts.text: Enable access through a separate device that requires adequate authentication

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Implement manual procedures that require a password change after each use.
texts.text: Implement manual procedures that require a password change after each use.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Request the vendor to add multiple user IDs.
texts.text: Request the vendor to add multiple user IDs.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Analyze the logs to detect unauthorized access.
texts.text: Analyze the logs to detect unauthorized access.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A.Enabling access through a separate device that requires adequate authentication allows authentication tokens tó be provisioned and terminated for individuals and also introduces the possibility of logging activity by individuals.
texts.text: A.Enabling access through a separate device that requires adequate authentication allows authentication tokens tó be provisioned and terminated for individuals and also introduces the possibility of logging activity by individuals.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Implementing manual procedures that require a password change after each use is not effective because users can circumvent the manual procedures.
texts.text: Implementing manual procedures that require a password change after each use is not effective because users can circumvent the manual procedures.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Vendor enhancements may take time and require development, and this is a critical device.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Analyzing the logs to detect unauthorized access could, in some cases, be an effective complementary control, but because such a control is detective, it would not be the most effective in this instance.
texts.text: Analyzing the logs to detect unauthorized access could, in some cases, be an effective complementary control, but because such a control is detective, it would not be the most effective in this instance.

texts.orig: 152. Which of the following is the MOST important process that an information security manager needs to negotiate with an outsourced service provider?
texts.text: Which of the following is the MOST important process that an information security manager needs to negotiate with an outsourced service provider?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The right to conduct independent security reviews
texts.text: The right to conduct independent security reviews

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. A legally binding data protection agreement
texts.text: A legally binding data protection agreement

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Encryption between the enterprise and the provider
texts.text: Encryption between the enterprise and the provider

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A joint risk assessment of the system
texts.text: A joint risk assessment of the system

texts.label: section_header

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A key requirement of an outsourced contract involving critical business systems is the establishment of the enterprise's right to conduct independent security reviews of the provider's security controls.
texts.text: A key requirement of an outsourced contract involving critical business systems is the establishment of the enterprise's right to conduct independent security reviews of the provider's security controls.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. A legally binding data protection agreement is also critical but secondary to conducting independent security reviews that permit examination of the actual security controls prevailing over the system, which is a more effective risk management tool.
texts.text: A legally binding data protection agreement is also critical but secondary to conducting independent security reviews that permit examination of the actual security controls prevailing over the system, which is a more effective risk management tool.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Network encryption of the link between the enterprise and the provider may well be a requirement but by itself will not provide the assurance of independent security reviews.
texts.text: Network encryption of the link between the enterprise and the provider may well be a requirement but by itself will not provide the assurance of independent security reviews.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A joint risk assessment of the system in conjunction with the outsourced provider may be a compromise solution should the right to conduct independent security reviews of the controls related to the system prove contractually difficult, but it is not the best option.
texts.text: A joint risk assessment of the system in conjunction with the outsourced provider may be a compromise solution should the right to conduct independent security reviews of the controls related to the system prove contractually difficult, but it is not the best option.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 160. For which of the following types of controls is notification of a verified network intrusion an indication that the control is workingproperly?
texts.text: For which of the following types of controls is notification of a verified network intrusion an indication that the control is workingproperly?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Preventative
texts.text: Preventative

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Corrective
texts.text: Corrective

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Detective
texts.text: Detective

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Deterrent
texts.text: Deterrent

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Preventative contrls, such as authentication mechanisms and encryption, are intended to stop intrusions, so a verified intrusion indicates that preventative controls were ineffective.
texts.text: Preventative contrls, such as authentication mechanisms and encryption, are intended to stop intrusions, so a verified intrusion indicates that preventative controls were ineffective.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Corrective controlș, such as backups and failover capabilities, are intended to offset the impact caused by successful attacks directed against information systems. Intrusions may not have impact at the time of their detection, so an intrusion does not unto itself offer any indications regarding the workings of corrective controls.
texts.text: Corrective controlș, such as backups and failover capabilities, are intended to offset the impact caused by successful attacks directed against information systems. Intrusions may not have impact at the time of their detection, so an intrusion does not unto itself offer any indications regarding the workings of corrective controls.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Detective controls, such as intrusion detection systems, are designed to alert staff to intrusions when they occur. Notification of a verified network intrusion is an indication that the control is working properly.
texts.text: Detective controls, such as intrusion detection systems, are designed to alert staff to intrusions when they occur. Notification of a verified network intrusion is an indication that the control is working properly.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Deterrent controls, such as warning banners, are intended to reduce the threat level by creating disincentives for threat events. A verified network intrusion indicates that the deterrent was inadequate for the responsible threat actor.
texts.text: Deterrent controls, such as warning banners, are intended to reduce the threat level by creating disincentives for threat events. A verified network intrusion indicates that the deterrent was inadequate for the responsible threat actor.

texts.text: ensure segregation of duties and limited access to sensitive data.

texts.orig: 168. The effectiveness of segregation of duties may be MOST seriously compromised when:
texts.text: The effectiveness of segregation of duties may be MOST seriously compromised when:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. user IDs of terminated staff remain active in application systems.
texts.text: user IDs of terminated staff remain active in application systems.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. access privileges are accumulated based on previous job functions.
texts.text: access privileges are accumulated based on previous job functions.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. application role-based access deviates from the organizational hierarchies.
texts.text: application role-based access deviates from the organizational hierarchies.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. role mining tools are used in the access privilege review.
texts.text: role mining tools are used in the access privilege review.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. It is not desirable to leave user IDs of terminated personnel or contractors active in the systems because it increases the potential for unauthorized access. However, the risk related to not effectively managing terminated users is an access management issue, not a segregation of duties issue.
texts.text: It is not desirable to leave user IDs of terminated personnel or contractors active in the systems because it increases the potential for unauthorized access. However, the risk related to not effectively managing terminated users is an access management issue, not a segregation of duties issue.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. When the changing of user roles is not adequately managed, access privileges may cross the boundary of segregation of duties. This often happens when a user's role changes as part of a promotion or transfer, and the user is assigned new system privileges to fulfill the new role but the privileges of the previous role are not removed.
texts.text: When the changing of user roles is not adequately managed, access privileges may cross the boundary of segregation of duties. This often happens when a user's role changes as part of a promotion or transfer, and the user is assigned new system privileges to fulfill the new role but the privileges of the previous role are not removed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Role-based access is built on the premise that users are granted those privileges that they need to perform their daily job functions (roles). These may not necessarily be aligned with the organizational hierarchies.
texts.text: Role-based access is built on the premise that users are granted those privileges that they need to perform their daily job functions (roles). These may not necessarily be aligned with the organizational hierarchies.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Using role mining tools in the access entitlement review may enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the process, particularly in large and complex environments.
texts.text: Using role mining tools in the access entitlement review may enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the process, particularly in large and complex environments.

texts.orig: 169. Which of the following BEST mitigates a situation in which an application programmer requires access to production data?

texts.orig: A. Create a separate account for the programmer as a power user.
texts.text: Create a separate account for the programmer as a power user.

texts.text: Log all the programmers' activity for review by supervisor.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Have the programmer sign a letter accepting full responsibility.

texts.text: Perform regular audits of the application.

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. It is not always possible to provide adequate segregation of duties between programming and operations in order to meet certain business requirements. A mitigating control is to record all the programmers' actions for later review by their supervisor, which would detect any inappropriate action on the part of the programmer.
texts.text: It is not always possible to provide adequate segregation of duties between programming and operations in order to meet certain business requirements. A mitigating control is to record all the programmers' actions for later review by their supervisor, which would detect any inappropriate action on the part of the programmer.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Having the programmer sign a letter accepting full responsibility is not an effective control.
texts.text: Having the programmer sign a letter accepting full responsibility is not an effective control.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Performing regular audits of the application is not relevant to determine if programmer activities are appropriate.

texts.orig: 171. What is the GREATEST risk when there are an excessive number of firewall rules?
texts.text: What is the GREATEST risk when there are an excessive number of firewall rules?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. One rule may override another rule in the chain and create a loophole.
texts.text: One rule may override another rule in the chain and create a loophole.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Performance degradation of the whole network may occur.
texts.text: Performance degradation of the whole network may occur.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The firewall may not support the increasing number of rules due to limitations.
texts.text: The firewall may not support the increasing number of rules due to limitations.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The firewall may show abnormal behavior and may crash or automatically shut down.
texts.text: The firewall may show abnormal behavior and may crash or automatically shut down.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. If there are many firewall rules, there is a chance that a particular rule may allow an external connection although other associated rules are overridden. Due to the increasing number of rules, it becomes complex to test them and, over time, a loophole may occur.
texts.text: If there are many firewall rules, there is a chance that a particular rule may allow an external connection although other associated rules are overridden. Due to the increasing number of rules, it becomes complex to test them and, over time, a loophole may occur.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Excessive firewall rules may impact network performance, but this is a secondary concern.
texts.text: Excessive firewall rules may impact network performance, but this is a secondary concern.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. It is unlikely that the capacity to support rules will exceed capacity and it is not a significant risk.
texts.text: It is unlikely that the capacity to support rules will exceed capacity and it is not a significant risk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. There is a slight risk that the firewall will behave erratically, but that is not the greatest risk.
texts.text: There is a slight risk that the firewall will behave erratically, but that is not the greatest risk.

texts.orig: 172. Which of the following is MOST likely to be discretionary?
texts.text: Which of the following is MOST likely to be discretionary?

texts.orig: A. Policies
texts.text: Policies

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Procedures
texts.text: Procedures

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Guidelines
texts.text: Guidelines

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Standards
texts.text: Standards

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Policies define management's security goals and expectations for an enterprise. These are defined in more specific terms within standards and procedures and cannot be discretionary.
texts.text: Policies define management's security goals and expectations for an enterprise. These are defined in more specific terms within standards and procedures and cannot be discretionary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Procedures describe how work is to be done and, as they are a defined set of actions, they cannot be discretionary.
texts.text: Procedures describe how work is to be done and, as they are a defined set of actions, they cannot be discretionary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Guidelines provide recommendations that business management must consider in developing practices within their areas of control; therefore, they are most likely to be discretionary.
texts.text: Guidelines provide recommendations that business management must consider in developing practices within their areas of control; therefore, they are most likely to be discretionary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Standards establish the allowable operational boundaries for people, processes and technology and cannot be discretionary.
texts.text: Standards establish the allowable operational boundaries for people, processes and technology and cannot be discretionary.

texts.text: 173. Which of the following are seldom changed in response to technological changes?

texts.orig: 174. What is the BEST way to ensure data protection upon termination of employment?
texts.text: What is the BEST way to ensure data protection upon termination of employment?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Retrieve identification badge and card keys.
texts.text: Retrieve identification badge and card keys.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Retrieve all personal computer equipment.
texts.text: Retrieve all personal computer equipment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Erase all the employee's folders.
texts.text: Erase all the employee's folders.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Ensure all logical access is removed.
texts.text: Ensure all logical access is removed.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Retrieving identification badge and card keys would only reduce the capability to enter the building.
texts.text: Retrieving identification badge and card keys would only reduce the capability to enter the building.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Retrieving the personal computer equipment is a necessary task but does not prevent access to resources.
texts.text: Retrieving the personal computer equipment is a necessary task but does not prevent access to resources.

texts.orig: C. Erasing the employee's folders is not reasonable because the folders may contain information important to the enterprise.
texts.text: Erasing the employee's folders is not reasonable because the folders may contain information important to the enterprise.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Ensuring that all logical access is removed will guarantee that the former employee will not be able to access company data and that the employee's credentials will not be misused.
texts.text: Ensuring that all logical access is removed will guarantee that the former employee will not be able to access company data and that the employee's credentials will not be misused.

texts.orig: 177. When creating an effective data-protection strategy, the information security manager must understand the flow of data and its protection at various stages. This is BEST achieved with:
texts.text: When creating an effective data-protection strategy, the information security manager must understand the flow of data and its protection at various stages. This is BEST achieved with:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. a third-party vulnerability assessment.
texts.text: a third-party vulnerability assessment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. a tailored methodology based on exposure.
texts.text: a tailored methodology based on exposure.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. an insurance policy for accidental data losses.
texts.text: an insurance policy for accidental data losses.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. a tokenization system set up in a secure network environment.
texts.text: a tokenization system set up in a secure network environment.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Vulnerability assessments, third-party or otherwise, do not provide information about data flow, risk or threats that is needed to create a data protection strategy.
texts.text: Vulnerability assessments, third-party or otherwise, do not provide information about data flow, risk or threats that is needed to create a data protection strategy.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 178. An account with full administrative privileges over a production file is found to be accessible by a member of the software development team. This account was set up to allow the developer to download nonsensitive production data for software testing purposes. Assuming all options are possible, which of the following should the information security manager recommend?
texts.text: An account with full administrative privileges over a production file is found to be accessible by a member of the software development team. This account was set up to allow the developer to download nonsensitive production data for software testing purposes. Assuming all options are possible, which of the following should the information security manager recommend?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Restrict account access to read-only.
texts.text: Restrict account access to read-only.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Log all usage of this account.
texts.text: Log all usage of this account.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Suspend the account and activate only when needed.
texts.text: Suspend the account and activate only when needed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Require that a change request be submitted for each download.
texts.text: Require that a change request be submitted for each download.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Administrative accounts have permission to change data. This is not required for the developers to perform their tasks. Unauthorized change will damage the integrity of the data. Restricting the account to read-only access will ensure that file integrity can be maintained while permitting access.
texts.text: Administrative accounts have permission to change data. This is not required for the developers to perform their tasks. Unauthorized change will damage the integrity of the data. Restricting the account to read-only access will ensure that file integrity can be maintained while permitting access.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Logging all usage of the account is a detective control and will not reduce the exposure created by this excessive level of access.
texts.text: Logging all usage of the account is a detective control and will not reduce the exposure created by this excessive level of access.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Suspending the account and activating only when needed will not reduce the exposure created by this excessive level of access.
texts.text: Suspending the account and activating only when needed will not reduce the exposure created by this excessive level of access.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Requiring that a change request be submitted for each download would be excessively burdensome and will not reduce the exposure created by this excessive level of access.
texts.text: Requiring that a change request be submitted for each download would be excessively burdensome and will not reduce the exposure created by this excessive level of access.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 179. Which of the following is the BEST indicator that security controls are performing effectively?
texts.text: Which of the following is the BEST indicator that security controls are performing effectively?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The monthly service level statistics indicate minimal impact from security issues.
texts.text: The monthly service level statistics indicate minimal impact from security issues.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The percentage of systems that are compliant with security standards is satisfactory.
texts.text: The percentage of systems that are compliant with security standards is satisfactory.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The cost of implementing security controls is less than the value of the assets.
texts.text: The cost of implementing security controls is less than the value of the assets.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Audit reports do not reflect any significant findings on security.
texts.text: Audit reports do not reflect any significant findings on security.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The best indicator of effective security control is the evidence of acceptable disruption to business operations.
texts.text: The best indicator of effective security control is the evidence of acceptable disruption to business operations.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The cost of implementing controls is unrelated to their effectiveness.
texts.text: The cost of implementing controls is unrelated to their effectiveness.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The percentage of systems that are compliant with security standards is not an indicator of their effectiveness.
texts.text: The percentage of systems that are compliant with security standards is not an indicator of their effectiveness.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Audit reports that do not reflect any significant findings on security can support this evidence, but this is generally not sufficiently frequent to be a useful management tool and is only supplemental to monthly service level statistics.
texts.text: Audit reports that do not reflect any significant findings on security can support this evidence, but this is generally not sufficiently frequent to be a useful management tool and is only supplemental to monthly service level statistics.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 180. Segregation of duties (SoD) has been designed and introduced into an accounts payable system. Which of the following should be in place to BEST maintain the effectiveness of SoD?
texts.text: Segregation of duties (SoD) has been designed and introduced into an accounts payable system. Which of the following should be in place to BEST maintain the effectiveness of SoD?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A strong password rule is assigned to disbursement staff.
texts.text: A strong password rule is assigned to disbursement staff.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Security awareness is publicized by the compliance department.
texts.text: Security awareness is publicized by the compliance department.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. An operational role matrix is aligned with the organizational chart.
texts.text: An operational role matrix is aligned with the organizational chart.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Access privilege is reviewed when an operator's role changes.
texts.text: Access privilege is reviewed when an operator's role changes.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Password strength is important for each staff member, but complexity of passwords does not ensure effectiveness of segregation of duties (SoD).
texts.text: Password strength is important for each staff member, but complexity of passwords does not ensure effectiveness of segregation of duties (SoD).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Effective SoD is not based on self-governance, so security awareness is an inadequate control for the same.
texts.text: Effective SoD is not based on self-governance, so security awareness is an inadequate control for the same.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. It is not uncommon for staff to have ancillary roles beyond what is shown on the organizational chart, so aligning a role matrix with the organizational chart is not sufficiently granular to maintain the effectiveness of SoD.
texts.text: It is not uncommon for staff to have ancillary roles beyond what is shown on the organizational chart, so aligning a role matrix with the organizational chart is not sufficiently granular to maintain the effectiveness of SoD.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. In order to maintain the effectiveness of SoD established in an application system, user access privilege must be reviewed whenever an operator's role changes. If this effort is neglected, there is a risk that a single staff member could acquire excessive operational capabilities. For instance, if a cash disbursement staff member accidentally acquires a trade input role, this person is technically able to accomplish an illegal payment operation.
texts.text: In order to maintain the effectiveness of SoD established in an application system, user access privilege must be reviewed whenever an operator's role changes. If this effort is neglected, there is a risk that a single staff member could acquire excessive operational capabilities. For instance, if a cash disbursement staff member accidentally acquires a trade input role, this person is technically able to accomplish an illegal payment operation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 181. Several business units reported problems with their systems after multiple security patches were deployed. What is the FIRST step to handle this problem?
texts.text: Several business units reported problems with their systems after multiple security patches were deployed. What is the FIRST step to handle this problem?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Assess the problems and institute rollback procedures, if needed.
texts.text: Assess the problems and institute rollback procedures, if needed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Disconnect the systems from the network until the problems are corrected.
texts.text: Disconnect the systems from the network until the problems are corrected.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Uninstall the patches from these systems.
texts.text: Uninstall the patches from these systems.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Contact the vendor regarding the problems that occurred.
texts.text: Contact the vendor regarding the problems that occurred.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Assessing the problems and instituting roliback procedures as needed would be the best course of action.
texts.text: Assessing the problems and instituting roliback procedures as needed would be the best course of action.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Disconnecting the systems from the network would not identify where the problem was and may make the problem worse.
texts.text: Disconnecting the systems from the network would not identify where the problem was and may make the problem worse.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Uninstalling the patches would not identify where the problem was and would recreate the risk the patches were meant to address.
texts.text: Uninstalling the patches would not identify where the problem was and would recreate the risk the patches were meant to address.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Contacting the vendor regarding the problems that occurred is part of the assessment.
texts.text: Contacting the vendor regarding the problems that occurred is part of the assessment.

texts.orig: 182. Information security frameworks can be MOST useful for the information security manager because they:
texts.text: Information security frameworks can be MOST useful for the information security manager because they:

texts.orig: A. provide detailed processes and methods.
texts.text: provide detailed processes and methods.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. are designed to achieve specific outcomes.
texts.text: are designed to achieve specific outcomes.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. provide structure and guidance.
texts.text: provide structure and guidance.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. provide policy and procedure.
texts.text: provide policy and procedure.

texts.label: section_header

texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Frameworks are general structures and will not provide detailed processes and methods.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Frameworks are like a skeleton; they provide the outlines and basic structure but not the specifics of process and outcomes.
texts.text: Frameworks are like a skeleton; they provide the outlines and basic structure but not the specifics of process and outcomes.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Frameworks do not specify particular outcomes but may provide the structure to assess outcomes against requirements.
texts.text: Frameworks do not specify particular outcomes but may provide the structure to assess outcomes against requirements.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 183. In which of the following situations is continuous monitoring the BEST option?
texts.text: In which of the following situations is continuous monitoring the BEST option?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Where incidents may have a high impact and frequency
texts.text: Where incidents may have a high impact and frequency

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Where incidents may have a high impact but low frequency
texts.text: Where incidents may have a high impact but low frequency

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Where legislation requires strong information security controls
texts.text: Where legislation requires strong information security controls

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Where e-commerce is a primary business driver
texts.text: Where e-commerce is a primary business driver

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Continuous monitoring control initiatives are expensive, so they should be used in areas where the risk is at its greatest level. These areas are the ones with high impact and high frequency of occurrence.
texts.text: Continuous monitoring control initiatives are expensive, so they should be used in areas where the risk is at its greatest level. These areas are the ones with high impact and high frequency of occurrence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Regulations and legislation that require tight IT security measures focus on requiring enterprises to establish an IT security governance structure that manages IT security with a risk-based approach, so each enterprise decides which kinds of controls are implemented. Continuous monitoring is not necessarily a requirement.
texts.text: Regulations and legislation that require tight IT security measures focus on requiring enterprises to establish an IT security governance structure that manages IT security with a risk-based approach, so each enterprise decides which kinds of controls are implemented. Continuous monitoring is not necessarily a requirement.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Continuous control monitoring initiatives are not needed in all e-commerce environments. There are some e-commerce environments where the impact of incidents is not high enough to support the implementation of this kind of initiative.
texts.text: Continuous control monitoring initiatives are not needed in all e-commerce environments. There are some e-commerce environments where the impact of incidents is not high enough to support the implementation of this kind of initiative.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Measures such as contingency planning or insurance are commonly used when incidents rarely happen but have a high impact each time they happen. Continuous monitoring is unlikely to be necessary.
texts.text: Measures such as contingency planning or insurance are commonly used when incidents rarely happen but have a high impact each time they happen. Continuous monitoring is unlikely to be necessary.
