texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. Which of the following should be determined FIRST when establishing a business continuity program?
texts.text: Which of the following should be determined FIRST when establishing a business continuity program?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Cost to rebuild information processing facilities
texts.text: Cost to rebuild information processing facilities

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Incremental daily cost of the unavailability of systems
texts.text: Incremental daily cost of the unavailability of systems

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Location and cost of offsite recovery facilities
texts.text: Location and cost of offsite recovery facilities

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Composition and mission of individual recovery teams
texts.text: Composition and mission of individual recovery teams

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The cost to rebuild information processing facilities would not be the first thing to determine.
texts.text: The cost to rebuild information processing facilities would not be the first thing to determine.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Prior to creating a detailed business continuity plan, it is important to determine the incremental daily cost of losing different systems. This will allow recovery time objectives to be determined.
texts.text: Prior to creating a detailed business continuity plan, it is important to determine the incremental daily cost of losing different systems. This will allow recovery time objectives to be determined.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Individual recovery team requirements will occur after the requirements for business continuity are determined.
texts.text: Individual recovery team requirements will occur after the requirements for business continuity are determined.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Location and cost of a recovery facility cannot be addressed until the potential losses are calculated, which will determine the type of recovery site that is needed—and this will affect cost.
texts.text: Location and cost of a recovery facility cannot be addressed until the potential losses are calculated, which will determine the type of recovery site that is needed—and this will affect cost.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. o o  ss    a   o     l y contracts a hot site. Which of the following would be the GREATEST weakness in recovery capability?
texts.text: o o  ss    a   o     l y contracts a hot site. Which of the following would be the GREATEST weakness in recovery capability?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Exclusive use of the hot site is limited to six weeks.
texts.text: Exclusive use of the hot site is limited to six weeks.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The hot site may have to be shared with other customers.
texts.text: The hot site may have to be shared with other customers.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The time of declaration determines site access priority.
texts.text: The time of declaration determines site access priority.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The provider services all major companies in the area.
texts.text: The provider services all major companies in the area.

texts.label: section_header

texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Access to a hot site is not indefinite; the recovery plan should address a long-term outage.
texts.text: Access to a hot site is not indefinite; the recovery plan should address a long-term outage.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. First come, first served is a standard practice in hosted facilities and does not constitute a major weakness.
texts.text: First come, first served is a standard practice in hosted facilities and does not constitute a major weakness.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Sharing a hot site facility is common practice and sometimes necessary in the case of a major disaster, and it is not a significant weakness.
texts.text: Sharing a hot site facility is common practice and sometimes necessary in the case of a major disaster, and it is not a significant weakness.

texts.orig: 3. Which of the following actions should be taken when an online trading company discovers a network attack in progress?
texts.text: Which of the following actions should be taken when an online trading company discovers a network attack in progress?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Shut off all network access points
texts.text: Shut off all network access points

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Dump all event logs to removable media
texts.text: Dump all event logs to removable media

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Isolate the affected network segment
texts.text: Isolate the affected network segment

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Enable trace logging on all events
texts.text: Enable trace logging on all events

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Shutting off all network access points would create a denial of service that could result in loss of revenue.
texts.text: Shutting off all network access points would create a denial of service that could result in loss of revenue.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Dumping event logs, while useful, would not mitigate the immediate threat posed by the network attack.
texts.text: Dumping event logs, while useful, would not mitigate the immediate threat posed by the network attack.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Isolating the affected network segment will mitigate the immediate threat while allowing unaffected portions of the business to continue processing.
texts.text: Isolating the affected network segment will mitigate the immediate threat while allowing unaffected portions of the business to continue processing.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Enabling trace logging, while useful, would not mitigate the immediate threat posed by the network attack.
texts.text: Enabling trace logging, while useful, would not mitigate the immediate threat posed by the network attack.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4. Which of the following choices should be assessed after the likelihood of a loss event has been determined?
texts.text: Which of the following choices should be assessed after the likelihood of a loss event has been determined?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The magnitude of impact
texts.text: The magnitude of impact

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Risk tolerance
texts.text: Risk tolerance

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The replacement cost of assets
texts.text: The replacement cost of assets

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The book value of assets
texts.text: The book value of assets

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Disaster recovery is driven by risk, which is a combination of likelihood and consequences. Once likelihood has been determined, the next step is to determine the magnitude of impact.
texts.text: Disaster recovery is driven by risk, which is a combination of likelihood and consequences. Once likelihood has been determined, the next step is to determine the magnitude of impact.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Risk tolerance is the acceptable deviation from acceptable risk. This is taken into account once risk has been quantified, which is dependent on determining the magnitude of impact.
texts.text: Risk tolerance is the acceptable deviation from acceptable risk. This is taken into account once risk has been quantified, which is dependent on determining the magnitude of impact.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Replacement cost is needed only when replacement is required.
texts.text: Replacement cost is needed only when replacement is required.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Book value does not represent actual asset value and cannot be used to measure magnitude of impact.
texts.text: Book value does not represent actual asset value and cannot be used to measure magnitude of impact.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5. What is the FIRST priority when responding to a major security incident?
texts.text: What is the FIRST priority when responding to a major security incident?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Documentation
texts.text: Documentation

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Monitoring
texts.text: Monitoring

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Restoration
texts.text: Restoration

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Containment
texts.text: Containment

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Documentation is important, but it should follow containment.
texts.text: Documentation is important, but it should follow containment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Monitoring is important and should be ongoing but does not limit the impact of the incident.
texts.text: Monitoring is important and should be ongoing but does not limit the impact of the incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Restoration follows containment.
texts.text: Restoration follows containment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The first priority in responding to a security incident is to contain it to limit the impact.
texts.text: The first priority in responding to a security incident is to contain it to limit the impact.

texts.orig: 6. Although control effectiveness has recently been tested, a serious compromise occurred. What is the FIRST action the information security manager should take?
texts.text: Although control effectiveness has recently been tested, a serious compromise occurred. What is the FIRST action the information security manager should take?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Evaluate control objectives.
texts.text: Evaluate control objectives.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Develop more stringent controls.
texts.text: Develop more stringent controls.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Perform a root cause analysis.
texts.text: Perform a root cause analysis.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Repeat the control test.
texts.text: Repeat the control test.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Control objectives cannot be evaluated until the exact nature of the compromise is understood; therefore, it is not clear how to best provide a solution.
texts.text: Control objectives cannot be evaluated until the exact nature of the compromise is understood; therefore, it is not clear how to best provide a solution.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Increasing the restrictiveness of controls should only take place if it is determined by root cause analysis to be necessary to solve the problem.
texts.text: Increasing the restrictiveness of controls should only take place if it is determined by root cause analysis to be necessary to solve the problem.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Assessing the root cause is the first step in understanding whether control objectives and controls are inadequate or if some other cause must be addressed.
texts.text: Assessing the root cause is the first step in understanding whether control objectives and controls are inadequate or if some other cause must be addressed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Repeating the control test does not provide a root cause of the compromise that occurred.
texts.text: Repeating the control test does not provide a root cause of the compromise that occurred.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 7. Which of the following is the MOST important element to ensure the success of a disster recovery test at a vendor-provided hot site?
texts.text: Which of the following is the MOST important element to ensure the success of a disster recovery test at a vendor-provided hot site?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Tests are scheduled on weekends.
texts.text: Tests are scheduled on weekends.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Network Internet Protocol addresses are predefined.
texts.text: Network Internet Protocol addresses are predefined.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Equipment at the hot site is identical.
texts.text: Equipment at the hot site is identical.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Business management actively participates.
texts.text: Business management actively participates.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Testing on weekends can be advantageous, but this is not the most important choice.
texts.text: Testing on weekends can be advantageous, but this is not the most important choice.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Because vendor-provided hot sites are in a state of constant change, it is not always possible to have network addresses defined in advance.
texts.text: Because vendor-provided hot sites are in a state of constant change, it is not always possible to have network addresses defined in advance.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Although it would be ideal to provide for identical equipment at the hot site, it is not always practical because multiple customers must be served and equipment specifications will vary.
texts.text: Although it would be ideal to provide for identical equipment at the hot site, it is not always practical because multiple customers must be served and equipment specifications will vary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Disaster recovery testing requires the allocation of sufficient resources to be successful. Without the support of management, these resources will not be available, and testing will suffer as a result.
texts.text: Disaster recovery testing requires the allocation of sufficient resources to be successful. Without the support of management, these resources will not be available, and testing will suffer as a result.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 8. At the conclusion of a disaster recovery test, which of the following should ALWAYS be performed prior to leaving the vendor's hot site facility?
texts.text: At the conclusion of a disaster recovery test, which of the following should ALWAYS be performed prior to leaving the vendor's hot site facility?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Erase data and software from devices.
texts.text: Erase data and software from devices.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Conduct a meeting to evaluate the test.
texts.text: Conduct a meeting to evaluate the test.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Complete an assessment of the hot site provider.
texts.text: Complete an assessment of the hot site provider.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Evaluate the results from all test scripts.
texts.text: Evaluate the results from all test scripts.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. For security and privacy reasons, all organizational data and software should be erased prior to departure.
texts.text: For security and privacy reasons, all organizational data and software should be erased prior to departure.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Evaluations can occur back at the office after everyone is rested.
texts.text: Evaluations can occur back at the office after everyone is rested.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. An assessment of the hot site provider should be included in the postmortem.
texts.text: An assessment of the hot site provider should be included in the postmortem.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Results of the test are a part of the postmortem.
texts.text: Results of the test are a part of the postmortem.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 10. How does a security information and event management solution MOST likely detect the existence of an advanced persistent threat in its infrastructure?
texts.text: How does a security information and event management solution MOST likely detect the existence of an advanced persistent threat in its infrastructure?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Through analysis of the network traffic history
texts.text: Through analysis of the network traffic history

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Through stateful inspection of firewall packets
texts.text: Through stateful inspection of firewall packets

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Through identification of zero-day attacks
texts.text: Through identification of zero-day attacks

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Through vulnerability assessments
texts.text: Through vulnerability assessments

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Advanced persistent threat (APT) refers to stealthy attacks not easily discovered without detailed analysis of behavior and traffic flows. Security information and event management (SIEM) solutions analyze network traffic over long periods of time to identify variances in behavior that may reveal APTs.
texts.text: Advanced persistent threat (APT) refers to stealthy attacks not easily discovered without detailed analysis of behavior and traffic flows. Security information and event management (SIEM) solutions analyze network traffic over long periods of time to identify variances in behavior that may reveal APTs.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Stateful inspection is a function of some firewalls but is not part of a SIEM solution. A stateful inspection firewall keeps track of the destination Internet Protocol address of each packet that leaves the enterprise's internal network. Whenever the response to a packet is received, its record is referenced to ascertain and ensure that the incoming message is in response to the request that went out from the enterprise.
texts.text: Stateful inspection is a function of some firewalls but is not part of a SIEM solution. A stateful inspection firewall keeps track of the destination Internet Protocol address of each packet that leaves the enterprise's internal network. Whenever the response to a packet is received, its record is referenced to ascertain and ensure that the incoming message is in response to the request that went out from the enterprise.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Zero-day attacks are not APTs because they are unknown until they manifest for the first time and cannot be proactively detected by SIEM solutions.
texts.text: Zero-day attacks are not APTs because they are unknown until they manifest for the first time and cannot be proactively detected by SIEM solutions.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A vulnerability assessment identifies areas that may potentially be exploited, but does not detect attempts at exploitation, so it is not related to APT.
texts.text: A vulnerability assessment identifies areas that may potentially be exploited, but does not detect attempts at exploitation, so it is not related to APT.

texts.orig: C. Identifying who launched the attack is not the primary purpose for a post-incident review because it should have been established during the response to the incident.

texts.orig: 12. What is the MOST important concern when an enterprise with multiple data centers designates one of its own facilities as the recovery site?
texts.text: What is the MOST important concern when an enterprise with multiple data centers designates one of its own facilities as the recovery site?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Communication line capacity between data centers
texts.text: Communication line capacity between data centers

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Current processing capacity loads at data centers
texts.text: Current processing capacity loads at data centers

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Differences in logical security at each center
texts.text: Differences in logical security at each center

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Synchronization of system software release versions
texts.text: Synchronization of system software release versions

texts.label: section_header

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: If data centers are operating at or near capacity, it may prove difficult to recover critical operations at an alternate data center.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Differences in logical security constitute a much easier issue to overcome and are, therefore, of less concern.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Synchronization of system software releases is a much easier issue to overcome and is, therefore, of less concern.
texts.text: Synchronization of system software releases is a much easier issue to overcome and is, therefore, of less concern.

texts.orig: 13. Which of the following is MOST important in determining whether a disaster recovery test is successful?
texts.text: Which of the following is MOST important in determining whether a disaster recovery test is successful?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Only business data files from offsite storage are used.
texts.text: Only business data files from offsite storage are used.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. IT staff fully recovers the processing infrastructure.
texts.text: IT staff fully recovers the processing infrastructure.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Critical business processes are duplicated.
texts.text: Critical business processes are duplicated.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. All systems are restored within recovery time objectives.
texts.text: All systems are restored within recovery time objectives.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Although ensuring that only materials taken from offsite:storage are used in the test is important, it is not as critical in determining a test's success.
texts.text: Although ensuring that only materials taken from offsite:storage are used in the test is important, it is not as critical in determining a test's success.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. While full recovery of the processing infrastructure is a key recovery milestone, it does not ensure the success of a test.
texts.text: While full recovery of the processing infrastructure is a key recovery milestone, it does not ensure the success of a test.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. To ensure that a disaster recovery test is successful, it is most important to determine whether all critical business functions were successfully recovered and duplicated.
texts.text: To ensure that a disaster recovery test is successful, it is most important to determine whether all critical business functions were successfully recovered and duplicated.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Achieving recovery time objectives is an important milestone, but it does not necessarily prove that the critical business functions can be conducted, due to interdepedencies with other applications and key elements such as data, staff, manual processes, materials and accessories, etc.
texts.text: Achieving recovery time objectives is an important milestone, but it does not necessarily prove that the critical business functions can be conducted, due to interdepedencies with other applications and key elements such as data, staff, manual processes, materials and accessories, etc.

texts.text: Location of a redundant processing facility and cost to build it

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Daily cost of losing critical systems and recovery time objectives
texts.text: Daily cost of losing critical systems and recovery time objectives

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Infrastructure complexity and system sensitivity

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Criticality results from the business impact analysis

texts.text: Infrastructure complexity and system sensitivity are the same whether in a third-party facility or not.

texts.text: Criticality is the same regardless of the alternate site choice.

texts.orig: 15. A new email virus that uses an attachment disguised as a picture file is spreading rapidly over the Internet. Which of the following should be performed FIRST in response to this threat?
texts.text: A new email virus that uses an attachment disguised as a picture file is spreading rapidly over the Internet. Which of the following should be performed FIRST in response to this threat?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Quarantine all picture files stored on file servers.
texts.text: Quarantine all picture files stored on file servers.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Block all emails containing picture file attachments.
texts.text: Block all emails containing picture file attachments.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Quarantine all mail servers connected to the Internet.
texts.text: Quarantine all mail servers connected to the Internet.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Block incoming Internet mail but permit outgoing mail.
texts.text: Block incoming Internet mail but permit outgoing mail.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. There is no indication of infection and quarantining all picture files is unnecessary.
texts.text: There is no indication of infection and quarantining all picture files is unnecessary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Until signature files can be updated, incoming email containing picture file attachments should be blocked.
texts.text: Until signature files can be updated, incoming email containing picture file attachments should be blocked.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Quarantine of all mail servers is unnecessary because only those emails containing attached picture files are in question.
texts.text: Quarantine of all mail servers is unnecessary because only those emails containing attached picture files are in question.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Blocking all incoming mail is unnecessary as long as picture files are blocked.
texts.text: Blocking all incoming mail is unnecessary as long as picture files are blocked.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Reboot the router connecting the demilitarized zone (DMZ) to the firewall.
texts.text: Reboot the router connecting the demilitarized zone (DMZ) to the firewall.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Power down all servers located on the DMZ segment.
texts.text: Power down all servers located on the DMZ segment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Monitor the probe and isolate the affected segment.
texts.text: Monitor the probe and isolate the affected segment.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Powering down the demilitarized zone servers is not warranted.

texts.text: In the case of a probe, the situation should be monitored and the affected network segment isolated.

texts.text: Enabling server trace routing is not warranted.

texts.orig: 17. An enterprise determined that if its email system failed for three days, the cost to the enterprise would be eight times greater than if it could be recovered in one day. This determination MOST likely was the result of:
texts.text: An enterprise determined that if its email system failed for three days, the cost to the enterprise would be eight times greater than if it could be recovered in one day. This determination MOST likely was the result of:

texts.label: list_item

texts.orig: 19. Which of the following is the MOST important element to ensure the successful recovery of a business during a disaster?
texts.text: Which of the following is the MOST important element to ensure the successful recovery of a business during a disaster?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Detailed technical recovery plans are maintained offsite.
texts.text: Detailed technical recovery plans are maintained offsite.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Network redundancy is maintained through separate providers.
texts.text: Network redundancy is maintained through separate providers.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Hot site equipment needs are recertified on a regular basis.
texts.text: Hot site equipment needs are recertified on a regular basis.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Appropriate declaration criteria have been established.
texts.text: Appropriate declaration criteria have been established.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. In a major disaster, staff can be injured or can be prevented from traveling to the hot site, so technical skills and business knowledge can be lost. It is, therefore, critical to maintain an updated copy of the detailed recovery plan at an offsite location. In a disaster situation, without the detailed technical plan, business recovery will be seriously impaired.
texts.text: In a major disaster, staff can be injured or can be prevented from traveling to the hot site, so technical skills and business knowledge can be lost. It is, therefore, critical to maintain an updated copy of the detailed recovery plan at an offsite location. In a disaster situation, without the detailed technical plan, business recovery will be seriously impaired.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Continuity of the business requires hot site infrastructure that is certified as compatible, along with clear criteria. Ideally, the business continuity program addresses these needs satisfactorily.
texts.text: Continuity of the business requires hot site infrastructure that is certified as compatible, along with clear criteria. Ideally, the business continuity program addresses these needs satisfactorily.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Continuity of the business requires adequate network redundancy. Ideally, the business continuity program addresses this satisfactorily.
texts.text: Continuity of the business requires adequate network redundancy. Ideally, the business continuity program addresses this satisfactorily.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Continuity of the business requires clear criteria for declaring a disaster. Ideally, the business continuity program addresses this satisfactorily.
texts.text: Continuity of the business requires clear criteria for declaring a disaster. Ideally, the business continuity program addresses this satisfactorily.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 20. Addressing the root cause of an incident is one aspect of which of the following incident management processes?
texts.text: Addressing the root cause of an incident is one aspect of which of the following incident management processes?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Eradication
texts.text: Eradication

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Recovery
texts.text: Recovery

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Lessons learned
texts.text: Lessons learned

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Containment
texts.text: Containment

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Determining the root cause of an incident and eliminating it are key activities that occur as part of the eradication process.
texts.text: Determining the root cause of an incident and eliminating it are key activities that occur as part of the eradication process.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Recovery focuses on restoring systems or services to conditions specified in service delivery objectives (SDOs) or business continuity plans (BCPs).
texts.text: Recovery focuses on restoring systems or services to conditions specified in service delivery objectives (SDOs) or business continuity plans (BCPs).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Lessons learned are documented at the end of the incident response process, after the root cause has been identified and remediated.
texts.text: Lessons learned are documented at the end of the incident response process, after the root cause has been identified and remediated.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Containment focuses on preventing the spread of damage associated with an incident, typically while the root cause either is still unknown or is known but cannot yet be remediated.
texts.text: Containment focuses on preventing the spread of damage associated with an incident, typically while the root cause either is still unknown or is known but cannot yet be remediated.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 21. An information security manager is investigating an internal cybersecurity incident and has been directed to preserve potential evidence. After creating an image copy of the hard drive of suspected systems with a commonly used tool and making copies on which to perform analysis, which of the following should the information security manager do NEXT?
texts.text: An information security manager is investigating an internal cybersecurity incident and has been directed to preserve potential evidence. After creating an image copy of the hard drive of suspected systems with a commonly used tool and making copies on which to perform analysis, which of the following should the information security manager do NEXT?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Encrypt the primary and backup hard drive images.
texts.text: Encrypt the primary and backup hard drive images.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Use an alternative tool to make an image copy of the hard drive.
texts.text: Use an alternative tool to make an image copy of the hard drive.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Generate hashes for the primary and backup hard drive images.
texts.text: Generate hashes for the primary and backup hard drive images.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Document the process used to make an image copy of the hard drive.
texts.text: Document the process used to make an image copy of the hard drive.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Ensuring the confidentiality of the memory dumps is not a primary concern during forensic analysis. Encrypted memory dumps cannot be analyzed.
texts.text: Ensuring the confidentiality of the memory dumps is not a primary concern during forensic analysis. Encrypted memory dumps cannot be analyzed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Generating hashes for the primary and backup memory dumps provides a means of demonstrating that the dump used for analysis is identical to the one stored for reference. It is essential that this step be performed before anything might happen to corrupt the original memory source, so it should be done as soon as possible.
texts.text: Generating hashes for the primary and backup memory dumps provides a means of demonstrating that the dump used for analysis is identical to the one stored for reference. It is essential that this step be performed before anything might happen to corrupt the original memory source, so it should be done as soon as possible.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. If a memory dump made with an alternative tool is desired, it should be made only after the existing primary and backup dumps have been hashed, so that their authenticity can be established if necessary.
texts.text: If a memory dump made with an alternative tool is desired, it should be made only after the existing primary and backup dumps have been hashed, so that their authenticity can be established if necessary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Documentation of the process should exist as part of the incident response procedures, but if it does not, the middle of an incident is not the best time to create it.
texts.text: Documentation of the process should exist as part of the incident response procedures, but if it does not, the middle of an incident is not the best time to create it.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 22. When an enterprise is using an automated tool to manage and house its business continuity plans, which of the following is the PRIMARY concern?
texts.text: When an enterprise is using an automated tool to manage and house its business continuity plans, which of the following is the PRIMARY concern?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Ensuring accessibility should a disaster occur
texts.text: Ensuring accessibility should a disaster occur

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Versioning control as plans are modified
texts.text: Versioning control as plans are modified

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Broken hyperlinks to resources stored elsewhere
texts.text: Broken hyperlinks to resources stored elsewhere

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Tracking changes in personnel and plan assets
texts.text: Tracking changes in personnel and plan assets

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. If all the plans exist only in electronic form, this presents a serious weakness, as the electronic version may be dependent on restoration of the intranet or other systems that are no longer available.
texts.text: If all the plans exist only in electronic form, this presents a serious weakness, as the electronic version may be dependent on restoration of the intranet or other systems that are no longer available.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Versioning control is actually easier with an automated system.
texts.text: Versioning control is actually easier with an automated system.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Tracking changes in personnel and plan assets is actually easier with an automated system.
texts.text: Tracking changes in personnel and plan assets is actually easier with an automated system.

texts.label: list_item

texts.orig: 23. The information security manager identifies a vulnerability in a publicly exposed business application during risk assessment activities. The NEXT step to take is:
texts.text: The information security manager identifies a vulnerability in a publicly exposed business application during risk assessment activities. The NEXT step to take is:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. containment.
texts.text: containment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. eradication.
texts.text: eradication.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. analysis.
texts.text: analysis.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. recovery.
texts.text: recovery.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Containment is necessary when an incident is found to have occurred. Prior to analysis, the information security manager has no way of knowing whether an incident may have occurred in the past or might even still be underway, so analysis should precede containment.
texts.text: Containment is necessary when an incident is found to have occurred. Prior to analysis, the information security manager has no way of knowing whether an incident may have occurred in the past or might even still be underway, so analysis should precede containment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Eradication is undertaken once an incident has been contained, which requires that it first be analyzed to determine its scope.
texts.text: Eradication is undertaken once an incident has been contained, which requires that it first be analyzed to determine its scope.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Identification of a vulnerability does not necessarily mean that an incident has occurred, but reliance on automated detection mechanisms when a vulnerability has been identified may allow any compromises that have already occurred to continue unimpeded. Analysis is appropriate to determine whether a threat actor may have already exploited the vulnerability and, if so, to determine the scope of the compromise.
texts.text: Identification of a vulnerability does not necessarily mean that an incident has occurred, but reliance on automated detection mechanisms when a vulnerability has been identified may allow any compromises that have already occurred to continue unimpeded. Analysis is appropriate to determine whether a threat actor may have already exploited the vulnerability and, if so, to determine the scope of the compromise.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Recovery is the last step taken before concluding an incident: At the time that a vulnerability is detected, there is no apparent impact, so recovery is not yet needed. Eradication and récovery will take place if an incident has occurred. However, it is important to first determine if an incident has taken place.

texts.orig: 37. A web server in a financial institution that has been compromised using a super-user account has been isolated, and proper forensic processes have been followed. What is the most appropriate next step?
texts.text: A web server in a financial institution that has been compromised using a super-user account has been isolated, and proper forensic processes have been followed. What is the most appropriate next step?

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Rebuild the server from the last verified backup.

texts.orig: 42. What is the PRIMARY factor that should be taken into consideration when designing the technical solution for a disaster recovery site?
texts.text: What is the PRIMARY factor that should be taken into consideration when designing the technical solution for a disaster recovery site?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Service delivery objective
texts.text: Service delivery objective

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Recovery time objective
texts.text: Recovery time objective

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Allowable interruption window
texts.text: Allowable interruption window

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Maximum tolerable outage
texts.text: Maximum tolerable outage

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The service delivery objective is the required level of functionality that must be supported during the alternate process mode until the normal situation is restored, which is directly related to business needs.
texts.text: The service delivery objective is the required level of functionality that must be supported during the alternate process mode until the normal situation is restored, which is directly related to business needs.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The recovery time objective (RTO) is commonly agreed to be the time frame between a disaster and the return to normal or acceptable operations defined by the service level objective. The RTO must be shorter than the allowable interruption window (AIW).
texts.text: The recovery time objective (RTO) is commonly agreed to be the time frame between a disaster and the return to normal or acceptable operations defined by the service level objective. The RTO must be shorter than the allowable interruption window (AIW).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The length of the AIW is defined by business management and determines the acceptable time frame between a disaster and the restoration of critical services and applications. AIW is generally based on the downtime before the enterprise suffers major financial damage. The technical implementation of the disaster recovery site will· be based on this constraint, especially the choice between a mirrored, hot, warm or cold site.
texts.text: The length of the AIW is defined by business management and determines the acceptable time frame between a disaster and the restoration of critical services and applications. AIW is generally based on the downtime before the enterprise suffers major financial damage. The technical implementation of the disaster recovery site will· be based on this constraint, especially the choice between a mirrored, hot, warm or cold site.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Maximum tolerable outage is the amount of time the enterprise can operate in alternate mode based on various factors such as accessibility and performance levels.
texts.text: Maximum tolerable outage is the amount of time the enterprise can operate in alternate mode based on various factors such as accessibility and performance levels.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The recovery time objective—the time between disaster and return to normal operation—will not have any impact on the backup strategy.

texts.orig: B. The recovery point objective defines the maximum loss of data acceptable by the business (i.e., age of data to be restored). It will directly determine the basic elements of the backup strategy frequency of the backups and what kind of backup is the most appropriate (disk-to-disk, on tape, mirroring).

texts.orig: 46. Which of the following situations would be of the MOST concern to a security manager?
texts.text: Which of the following situations would be of the MOST concern to a security manager?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Audit logs are not enabled on a production server.
texts.text: Audit logs are not enabled on a production server.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The logon ID for a terminated systems analyst still exists on the system.
texts.text: The logon ID for a terminated systems analyst still exists on the system.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The help desk has received numerous reports of users receiving phishing emails.
texts.text: The help desk has received numerous reports of users receiving phishing emails.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: A Trojan was found installed on a systems administrator's laptop.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Failure to enable audit logs on a production server, although important, does not pose as immediate or as critical a threat as a Trojan installed on a systems administrator's laptop.
texts.text: Failure to enable audit logs on a production server, although important, does not pose as immediate or as critical a threat as a Trojan installed on a systems administrator's laptop.

texts.text: Numerous reports of phishing emails are a risk. But in this situation, employees recognize the threat and are responding appropriately, so it is not a critical threat.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 47. A customer credit card database has been reported as being breached by hackers. What is the FIRST step in dealing with this attack?
texts.text: A customer credit card database has been reported as being breached by hackers. What is the FIRST step in dealing with this attack?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Confirm the incident.
texts.text: Confirm the incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Notify senior management.
texts.text: Notify senior management.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Start containment.
texts.text: Start containment.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Notify law enforcement.
texts.text: Notify law enforcement.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Validating that the condition is a true security incident is the necessary first step in determining the correct response.
texts.text: Validating that the condition is a true security incident is the necessary first step in determining the correct response.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Notifying senior management could be part of the incident response process that takes place after confirming an incident.
texts.text: Notifying senior management could be part of the incident response process that takes place after confirming an incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The containment stage would follow confirming the incident.
texts.text: The containment stage would follow confirming the incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Notifying law enforcement by the appropriate party could be part of the incident response process that takes place after confirming an incident.
texts.text: Notifying law enforcement by the appropriate party could be part of the incident response process that takes place after confirming an incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 48. A root kit was used to capture detailed accounts receivable information. What is the next step to ensure admissibility of evidence from a legal standpoint, once the incident has been identified and the server isolated?
texts.text: A root kit was used to capture detailed accounts receivable information. What is the next step to ensure admissibility of evidence from a legal standpoint, once the incident has been identified and the server isolated?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Document how the attack occurred.
texts.text: Document how the attack occurred.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Notify law enforcement.
texts.text: Notify law enforcement.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Take an image copy of the media.
texts.text: Take an image copy of the media.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Close the accounts receivable system.
texts.text: Close the accounts receivable system.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Documentation follows taking an image copy and may be supplementary.
texts.text: Documentation follows taking an image copy and may be supplementary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Notifying law enforcement follows taking an image copy, preserving evidence and maintaining the chain of custody.
texts.text: Notifying law enforcement follows taking an image copy, preserving evidence and maintaining the chain of custody.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Taking an image copy of the media along with preserving any other evidence and maintaining the chain of custody is a recommended practice to ensure legal admissibility.
texts.text: Taking an image copy of the media along with preserving any other evidence and maintaining the chain of custody is a recommended practice to ensure legal admissibility.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Closing the accounts receivable system is not a practical solution.
texts.text: Closing the accounts receivable system is not a practical solution.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 49. Which of the following is MOST important when collecting evidence for forensic analysis?
texts.text: Which of the following is MOST important when collecting evidence for forensic analysis?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Ensure the assignment of qualified personnel.
texts.text: Ensure the assignment of qualified personnel.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Request the IT department do an image copy.
texts.text: Request the IT department do an image copy.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Disconnect from the network and isolate the affected devices.
texts.text: Disconnect from the network and isolate the affected devices.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Ensure law enforcement personnel are present before the forensic analysis commences.
texts.text: Ensure law enforcement personnel are present before the forensic analysis commences.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Without the initial assignment of forensic expertise, the required levels of evidence may not be preserved properly.
texts.text: Without the initial assignment of forensic expertise, the required levels of evidence may not be preserved properly.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The IT department is unlikely to have the necessary level of expertise and should, therefore, be prevented from taking action.
texts.text: The IT department is unlikely to have the necessary level of expertise and should, therefore, be prevented from taking action.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Disconnecting from the network may be a prudent step prior to collecting evidence but does not eliminate the requirement for properly qualified forensic personnel.
texts.text: Disconnecting from the network may be a prudent step prior to collecting evidence but does not eliminate the requirement for properly qualified forensic personnel.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Notifying law enforcement will likely occur after the forensic analysis has been completed.
texts.text: Notifying law enforcement will likely occur after the forensic analysis has been completed.

texts.text: Which one of the following measures will BEST indicate the effectiveness of an incident response process?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Number of open incidents
texts.text: Number of open incidents

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Reduction of the number of security incidents
texts.text: Reduction of the number of security incidents

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Reduction of the average response time to an incident
texts.text: Reduction of the average response time to an incident

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: section_header

texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The total number of open incidents is not an indicator of incident response effectiveness because the team does not have direct control over the number of incidents it must handle at any given time.
texts.text: The total number of open incidents is not an indicator of incident response effectiveness because the team does not have direct control over the number of incidents it must handle at any given time.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Reduction of the number of security incidents generally cannot be attributed to the effectiveness of the response team but rather to improved controls.
texts.text: Reduction of the number of security incidents generally cannot be attributed to the effectiveness of the response team but rather to improved controls.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Reduction of response time helps minimize the impact of the incident and is the best indicator of the effectiveness of the incident response process.
texts.text: Reduction of response time helps minimize the impact of the incident and is the best indicator of the effectiveness of the incident response process.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The number of incidents handled per month would not be a direct indicator of team effectiveness.
texts.text: The number of incidents handled per month would not be a direct indicator of team effectiveness.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 52. A database was compromised by guessing the password for a shared administrative account and confidential customer information was stolen. The information security manager was able to detect this breach by analyzing which of the following?
texts.text: A database was compromised by guessing the password for a shared administrative account and confidential customer information was stolen. The information security manager was able to detect this breach by analyzing which of the following?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Invalid logon attempts
texts.text: Invalid logon attempts

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Write access violations
texts.text: Write access violations

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Concurrent logons
texts.text: Concurrent logons

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Firewall logs
texts.text: Firewall logs

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Because the password for the shared administrative account was obtained through guessing, it is probable that there were multiple unsuccessful logon attempts before the correct password was deduced. Searching the logs for invalid logon attempts could, therefore, lead to the discovery of this unauthorized activity.
texts.text: Because the password for the shared administrative account was obtained through guessing, it is probable that there were multiple unsuccessful logon attempts before the correct password was deduced. Searching the logs for invalid logon attempts could, therefore, lead to the discovery of this unauthorized activity.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Write access violations would not necessarily be observed because the information was merely copied and not altered.
texts.text: Write access violations would not necessarily be observed because the information was merely copied and not altered.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Because the account is shared, reviewing the logs for concurrent logons would not reveal unauthorized activity; concurrent usage is common in this situation.
texts.text: Because the account is shared, reviewing the logs for concurrent logons would not reveal unauthorized activity; concurrent usage is common in this situation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Firewall logs would not necessarily contain information regarding logon attempts.
texts.text: Firewall logs would not necessarily contain information regarding logon attempts.

texts.orig: 53. The post-incident review. of a security incident revealed that there was a process that was not monitored. As a result, monitoring functionality has been implemented. Which of the following may BEST.be expected from this remediation?
texts.text: The post-incident review. of a security incident revealed that there was a process that was not monitored. As a result, monitoring functionality has been implemented. Which of the following may BEST.be expected from this remediation?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Reduction in total incident duration
texts.text: Reduction in total incident duration

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Increase in risk tolerance
texts.text: Increase in risk tolerance

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Improvement in identification
texts.text: Improvement in identification

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Facilitation of escalation
texts.text: Facilitation of escalation

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Monitoring may cause incident duration to become longer, as each event is investigated and possibly escalated for further remediation.
texts.text: Monitoring may cause incident duration to become longer, as each event is investigated and possibly escalated for further remediation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Risk tolerance is a determination made by senior management based on the results of a risk analysis and the amount of risk senior management believes the enterprise can manage effectively. Risk tolerance will not change from implementation of a monitoring process.
texts.text: Risk tolerance is a determination made by senior management based on the results of a risk analysis and the amount of risk senior management believes the enterprise can manage effectively. Risk tolerance will not change from implementation of a monitoring process.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. When a key process is not monitored, that lack of monitoring may lead to a security vulnerability or threat going undiscovered, resulting in a security incident. Once consistent monitoring is implemented, identification of vulnerabilities and threats will improve.
texts.text: When a key process is not monitored, that lack of monitoring may lead to a security vulnerability or threat going undiscovered, resulting in a security incident. Once consistent monitoring is implemented, identification of vulnerabilities and threats will improve.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Monitoring itself is simply an identification and reporting tool; it has little bearing on how information is escalated to other staff members for investigation and resolution.
texts.text: Monitoring itself is simply an identification and reporting tool; it has little bearing on how information is escalated to other staff members for investigation and resolution.

texts.orig: 55. An enterprise has been experiencing a number of network-based security attacks that all appear to originate internally. What is the BEST course of action?
texts.text: An enterprise has been experiencing a number of network-based security attacks that all appear to originate internally. What is the BEST course of action?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Require the use of strong passwords.
texts.text: Require the use of strong passwords.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Assign static Internet Protocol addresses.
texts.text: Assign static Internet Protocol addresses.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Implement centralized logging software.
texts.text: Implement centralized logging software.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Install an intrusion detection system.
texts.text: Install an intrusion detection system.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Requiring the use of strong passwords will not be sufficiently effective against an internal network-based attack.
texts.text: Requiring the use of strong passwords will not be sufficiently effective against an internal network-based attack.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Assigning Internet Protocol (IP) addresses would not be effective since these can be spoofed.
texts.text: Assigning Internet Protocol (IP) addresses would not be effective since these can be spoofed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Installing an intrusion detection system (IDS) will allow the information security manager to better pinpoint the source of the attack so that countermeasures may then be taken. An IDS is not limited to detection of attacks originating externally. Proper placement of agents on the internal network can be-effectively used to detect an internally based attack.
texts.text: Installing an intrusion detection system (IDS) will allow the information security manager to better pinpoint the source of the attack so that countermeasures may then be taken. An IDS is not limited to detection of attacks originating externally. Proper placement of agents on the internal network can be-effectively used to detect an internally based attack.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Implementing centralized logging software will not necessarily provide information on the source of the attack.
texts.text: Implementing centralized logging software will not necessarily provide information on the source of the attack.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 56. Serious security incidents typically lead to renewed focus by management on information security that then usually fades over time. What opportunity should the information security manager seize to BEST use this renewed focus?
texts.text: Serious security incidents typically lead to renewed focus by management on information security that then usually fades over time. What opportunity should the information security manager seize to BEST use this renewed focus?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. To improve the integration of business and information security processes
texts.text: To improve the integration of business and information security processes

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. To increase information security budgets and staffing levels
texts.text: To increase information security budgets and staffing levels

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. To develop tighter controls and stronger compliance efforts
texts.text: To develop tighter controls and stronger compliance efforts

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. To acquire better supplemental technical security controls
texts.text: To acquire better supplemental technical security controls

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Close integration of information security governance with overall enterprise governance is likely to provide better long-term information security by institutionalizing activities and increasing visibility in all organizational activities.
texts.text: Close integration of information security governance with overall enterprise governance is likely to provide better long-term information security by institutionalizing activities and increasing visibility in all organizational activities.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Control strength and compliance efforts must be balanced against business requirements, culture and other organizational factors and are best undertaken at the governance level.
texts.text: Control strength and compliance efforts must be balanced against business requirements, culture and other organizational factors and are best undertaken at the governance level.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Increased budgets and staff may improve information security but will not have the same beneficial impact as incorporating security into the strategic levels of the enterprise's operations.
texts.text: Increased budgets and staff may improve information security but will not have the same beneficial impact as incorporating security into the strategic levels of the enterprise's operations.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. While technical security controls may improve some aspects of security, they will not address management issues or provide the enduring organizational changes needed for improved maturity levels.

texts.label: list_item

texts.orig: 58. Which of the following processes is critical for deciding prioritization of actions in a business continuity plan?
texts.text: Which of the following processes is critical for deciding prioritization of actions in a business continuity plan?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Business impact analysis
texts.text: Business impact analysis

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Risk assessment
texts.text: Risk assessment

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Vulnerability assessment
texts.text: Vulnerability assessment

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Business process mapping
texts.text: Business process mapping

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A business impact analysis (BIA) provides results, such as impact from a security incident and required response times. The BIA is the most critical process for deciding which part of the information system/business process should be given prioritization in case of a security incident.
texts.text: A business impact analysis (BIA) provides results, such as impact from a security incident and required response times. The BIA is the most critical process for deciding which part of the information system/business process should be given prioritization in case of a security incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Risk assessment is a very important process for the creation of a business continuity plan. Risk assessment provides information on the likelihood of occurrence of security incidents and assists in the selection of countermeasures but not in their prioritization.
texts.text: Risk assessment is a very important process for the creation of a business continuity plan. Risk assessment provides information on the likelihood of occurrence of security incidents and assists in the selection of countermeasures but not in their prioritization.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A vulnerability assessment provides information regarding the security weaknesses of the system, supporting the risk analysis process.
texts.text: A vulnerability assessment provides information regarding the security weaknesses of the system, supporting the risk analysis process.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Business process mapping facilitates the creation of the plan by providing mapping guidance on actions after the decision on critical business processes has been made—translating business prioritization to IT prioritization. Business process mapping helps not in making a decision but in implementing a decision.
texts.text: Business process mapping facilitates the creation of the plan by providing mapping guidance on actions after the decision on critical business processes has been made—translating business prioritization to IT prioritization. Business process mapping helps not in making a decision but in implementing a decision.

texts.orig: 61. During the security review of organizational servers it was found that a file server contairing confidential human resources (HR) data was accessible to all user IDs. What is the FIRST step the security manager should perform?
texts.text: During the security review of organizational servers it was found that a file server contairing confidential human resources (HR) data was accessible to all user IDs. What is the FIRST step the security manager should perform?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Copy sample files as evidence.
texts.text: Copy sample files as evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Remove access privileges to the folder containing the data.
texts.text: Remove access privileges to the folder containing the data.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Report this situation to the data owner.
texts.text: Report this situation to the data owner.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Train the HR team on properly controlling file permissions.
texts.text: Train the HR team on properly controlling file permissions.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Copying sample files as evidence is not advisable because it breaches confidentiality requirements on the file.
texts.text: Copying sample files as evidence is not advisable because it breaches confidentiality requirements on the file.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Removing access privileges to the folder containing the data should be done by the data owner or by the security manager in consultation with the data owner—frequently the security manager would not have this right; regardless, this would be done only after formally reporting the incident. .
texts.text: Removing access privileges to the folder containing the data should be done by the data owner or by the security manager in consultation with the data owner—frequently the security manager would not have this right; regardless, this would be done only after formally reporting the incident. .

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The data owner should be notified prior to any action being taken.
texts.text: The data owner should be notified prior to any action being taken.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Training the human resources team on properly controlling file permissions is the method to prevent such incidents in the future, but this should take place after the incident reporting and investigation activities are completed.
texts.text: Training the human resources team on properly controlling file permissions is the method to prevent such incidents in the future, but this should take place after the incident reporting and investigation activities are completed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 62. What is the PRIMARY focus if an enterprise considers taking legal action on a security incident?
texts.text: What is the PRIMARY focus if an enterprise considers taking legal action on a security incident?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Obtaining evidence as soon as possible
texts.text: Obtaining evidence as soon as possible

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Preserving the integrity of the evidence
texts.text: Preserving the integrity of the evidence

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Disconnecting all IT equipment involved
texts.text: Disconnecting all IT equipment involved

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Reconstructing the sequence of events
texts.text: Reconstructing the sequence of events

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Obtaining evidence as soon as possible is part of the investigative procedure but is not as important as preserving the integrity of the evidence.
texts.text: Obtaining evidence as soon as possible is part of the investigative procedure but is not as important as preserving the integrity of the evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The integrity of evidence should be kept, following the appropriate forensic techniques to obtain the evidence and a chain of custody procedure to maintain the evidence (in order to be accepted in a court of law).
texts.text: The integrity of evidence should be kept, following the appropriate forensic techniques to obtain the evidence and a chain of custody procedure to maintain the evidence (in order to be accepted in a court of law).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Disconnecting involved IT equipment is part of the investigative procedure but is not as important as preserving the integrity of the evidence.
texts.text: Disconnecting involved IT equipment is part of the investigative procedure but is not as important as preserving the integrity of the evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Reconstructing the sequence of events is part of the investigative procedure but is not as important as preserving the integrity of the evidence.
texts.text: Reconstructing the sequence of events is part of the investigative procedure but is not as important as preserving the integrity of the evidence.
