texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 81. In the course of examining a computer system for forensic evidence, data on the suspect media were inadvertently altered. Which of the following should have been the FIRST course of action in the investigative process?
texts.text: In the course of examining a computer system for forensic evidence, data on the suspect media were inadvertently altered. Which of the following should have been the FIRST course of action in the investigative process?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Perform a backup of the suspect media to new media.
texts.text: Perform a backup of the suspect media to new media.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Create a bit-for-bit image of the original media source onto new media.
texts.text: Create a bit-for-bit image of the original media source onto new media.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Make a copy of all files that are relevant to the investigation.
texts.text: Make a copy of all files that are relevant to the investigation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Run an error-checking program on all logical drives to ensure there are no disk errors.
texts.text: Run an error-checking program on all logical drives to ensure there are no disk errors.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A backup does not preserve 100 percent of the data, such as erased or deleted files and data in slack space—which may be critical to the investigative process.
texts.text: A backup does not preserve 100 percent of the data, such as erased or deleted files and data in slack space—which may be critical to the investigative process.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The original hard drive or suspect media should never be used as the source for analysis. The source or original media should be physically secured and only used as the master to create a bit-for-bit image. The original should be stored using the appropriate chain of custody procedures, depending on location. The image created for forensic analysis should be used for analysis.
texts.text: The original hard drive or suspect media should never be used as the source for analysis. The source or original media should be physically secured and only used as the master to create a bit-for-bit image. The original should be stored using the appropriate chain of custody procedures, depending on location. The image created for forensic analysis should be used for analysis.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Once data from the source are altered, they may no longer be admissible in court.
texts.text: Once data from the source are altered, they may no longer be admissible in court.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Continuing the investigation and documenting the date, time and data altered are actions that may not be admissible in legal proceedings. The enterprise would need to know the details of collecting and preserving forensic evidence relevant to the jurisdiction.
texts.text: Continuing the investigation and documenting the date, time and data altered are actions that may not be admissible in legal proceedings. The enterprise would need to know the details of collecting and preserving forensic evidence relevant to the jurisdiction.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 82. Which of the following recovery strategies has the GREATEST chance of failure?
texts.text: Which of the following recovery strategies has the GREATEST chance of failure?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Hot site
texts.text: Hot site

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Redundant site
texts.text: Redundant site

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Reciprocal arrangement
texts.text: Reciprocal arrangement

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Cold site
texts.text: Cold site

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A hot site is incorrect because it is a site kept fully equipped with processing capabilities and other services by the vendor.
texts.text: A hot site is incorrect because it is a site kept fully equipped with processing capabilities and other services by the vendor.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. A redundant site is incorrect because it is a site equipped and configured exactly like the primary site.
texts.text: A redundant site is incorrect because it is a site equipped and configured exactly like the primary site.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A reciprocal arrangement is an agreement that allows two enterprises to back up each other during a disaster. This approach sounds desirable, but it has the greatest chance of failure due to problems in keeping agreements and plans up to date and providing adequate processing capacity.
texts.text: A reciprocal arrangement is an agreement that allows two enterprises to back up each other during a disaster. This approach sounds desirable, but it has the greatest chance of failure due to problems in keeping agreements and plans up to date and providing adequate processing capacity.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A cold site is incorrect because it is a building that has a basic environment such as electrical wiring, air conditioning, flooring, etc., and is ready to receive equipment in order to operate.
texts.text: A cold site is incorrect because it is a building that has a basic environment such as electrical wiring, air conditioning, flooring, etc., and is ready to receive equipment in order to operate.

texts.orig: 83. Recovery point objectives can be used to determine which of the following?
texts.text: Recovery point objectives can be used to determine which of the following?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Maximum tolerable period of data loss
texts.text: Maximum tolerable period of data loss

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Maximum tolerable downtime
texts.text: Maximum tolerable downtime

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Baseline for operational resiliency
texts.text: Baseline for operational resiliency

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Time to restore backups
texts.text: Time to restore backups

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The recovery point objective (RPO) is determined based on the acceptable data loss in the case of disruption of operations. RPOs effectively quantify the permissible amount of data loss in the case of interruption.
texts.text: The recovery point objective (RPO) is determined based on the acceptable data loss in the case of disruption of operations. RPOs effectively quantify the permissible amount of data loss in the case of interruption.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. RPO cannot be used to determine allowable down time.
texts.text: RPO cannot be used to determine allowable down time.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. RPO does not set the baseline for operational resiliency.
texts.text: RPO does not set the baseline for operational resiliency.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. RPO will determine the required frequency and type of backup. The shorter the RPO, the more frequent the backups.
texts.text: RPO will determine the required frequency and type of backup. The shorter the RPO, the more frequent the backups.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 84. Which of the following choices is the PRIMARY purpose of maintaining an information security incident history?
texts.text: Which of the following choices is the PRIMARY purpose of maintaining an information security incident history?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. To provide evidence for forensic analysis
texts.text: To provide evidence for forensic analysis

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. To record progress and document exceptions
texts.text: To record progress and document exceptions

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. To determine a severity classification of incidents
texts.text: To determine a severity classification of incidents

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. To track errors to assign accountability
texts.text: To track errors to assign accountability

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Recording incidents helps in providing evidence of forensic analysis in case legal action is required. Providing evidence for forensic analysis may or may not be the primary requirement for all incidents.
texts.text: Recording incidents helps in providing evidence of forensic analysis in case legal action is required. Providing evidence for forensic analysis may or may not be the primary requirement for all incidents.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Recording information security incidents helps in maintaining a record of events from detection of the incident to closure of the incident. This helps the incident management teams to ensure that all related aspects required for resolving, closing and preventing reocurrence of incidents are covered.
texts.text: Recording information security incidents helps in maintaining a record of events from detection of the incident to closure of the incident. This helps the incident management teams to ensure that all related aspects required for resolving, closing and preventing reocurrence of incidents are covered.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Recording incidents helps in identifying all required parameters for determining a severity classification; however, incident management is focused on containment, prevention and recovery.
texts.text: Recording incidents helps in identifying all required parameters for determining a severity classification; however, incident management is focused on containment, prevention and recovery.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Tracking errors to assign accountability is not the primary purpose for recording details of information security incidents. Process improvement is the primary purpose.
texts.text: Tracking errors to assign accountability is not the primary purpose for recording details of information security incidents. Process improvement is the primary purpose.

texts.orig: 85. When electronically stored information is requested during a fraud investigation, which of the following should be the FIRST priority?
texts.text: When electronically stored information is requested during a fraud investigation, which of the following should be the FIRST priority?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Assigning responsibility for acquiring the data
texts.text: Assigning responsibility for acquiring the data

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Locating the data and preserving the integrity of the data
texts.text: Locating the data and preserving the integrity of the data

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Creating a forensically sound image
texts.text: Creating a forensically sound image

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Issuing a litigation hold to all affected parties
texts.text: Issuing a litigation hold to all affected parties

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. While assigning responsibility for acquiring the data is a step that should be taken, it is not the first step or the highest priority.
texts.text: While assigning responsibility for acquiring the data is a step that should be taken, it is not the first step or the highest priority.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Locating the data and preserving data integrity are the first priorities.
texts.text: Locating the data and preserving data integrity are the first priorities.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Issuing a litigation hold to all affected parties might be a necessary step early in an investigation of certain types, but not the first priority.
texts.text: Issuing a litigation hold to all affected parties might be a necessary step early in an investigation of certain types, but not the first priority.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Creating a forensically sound image may or may not be a necessary step, depending on the type of investigation, but it would never be the first priority.
texts.text: Creating a forensically sound image may or may not be a necessary step, depending on the type of investigation, but it would never be the first priority.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 86."When creating a forensic image of a hard drive, which of the following should be the FIRST step?
texts.text: 86."When creating a forensic image of a hard drive, which of the following should be the FIRST step?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Identify a recognized forensics software tool to create the image.
texts.text: Identify a recognized forensics software tool to create the image.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Establish a chain of custody log.
texts.text: Establish a chain of custody log.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Connect the hard drive to a write blocker.
texts.text: Connect the hard drive to a write blocker.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Generate a cryptographic hash of the hard drive contents.
texts.text: Generate a cryptographic hash of the hard drive contents.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Identifying a recognized forensics software tool to create the image is one of the important steps, but it should come after several of the other options.
texts.text: Identifying a recognized forensics software tool to create the image is one of the important steps, but it should come after several of the other options.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The first step in any investigation requiring the creation of a forensic image should always be to maintain the chain of custody.
texts.text: The first step in any investigation requiring the creation of a forensic image should always be to maintain the chain of custody.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Connecting the hard drive to a write blocker is an important step, but it must be done after the chain of custody has been established.
texts.text: Connecting the hard drive to a write blocker is an important step, but it must be done after the chain of custody has been established.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Generating a cryptographic hash of the hard drive contents is another important subsequent step.
texts.text: Generating a cryptographic hash of the hard drive contents is another important subsequent step.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 87. When a significant security breach occurs, what should be reported FIRST to senior management?
texts.text: When a significant security breach occurs, what should be reported FIRST to senior management?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A summary of the security logs that illustrates the sequence of events
texts.text: A summary of the security logs that illustrates the sequence of events

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. An explanation of the incident and corrective action taken
texts.text: An explanation of the incident and corrective action taken

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. An analysis of the impact of similar attacks at other enterprises
texts.text: An analysis of the impact of similar attacks at other enterprises

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A business case for implementing stronger logical access controls
texts.text: A business case for implementing stronger logical access controls

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A summary of security logs would be too technical to report to senior management.
texts.text: A summary of security logs would be too technical to report to senior management.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. When reporting an incident to senior management, the initial information to be communicated should include an explanation of what happened and how the breach was resolved.
texts.text: When reporting an incident to senior management, the initial information to be communicated should include an explanation of what happened and how the breach was resolved.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. An analysis of the impact of similar attacks would be desirable; however, it would be communicated later in the process.
texts.text: An analysis of the impact of similar attacks would be desirable; however, it would be communicated later in the process.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A business case for improving controls may be appropriate after investigating the cause of the breach.
texts.text: A business case for improving controls may be appropriate after investigating the cause of the breach.

texts.orig: 88. The BEST time to determine who should be responsible for declaring a disaster is:
texts.text: The BEST time to determine who should be responsible for declaring a disaster is:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. during the establishment of the plan.
texts.text: during the establishment of the plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. after an incident has been confirmed by operations staff.
texts.text: after an incident has been confirmed by operations staff.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. after fully testing the incident management plan.
texts.text: after fully testing the incident management plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. after the implementation details of the plan have been approved.
texts.text: after the implementation details of the plan have been approved.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Roles and responsibilities for all involved in incident response should be established when the incident response plan is established.
texts.text: Roles and responsibilities for all involved in incident response should be established when the incident response plan is established.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Determining roles and responsibilities during a disaster is not the best time to make such decisions, unless it is absolutely necessary.
texts.text: Determining roles and responsibilities during a disaster is not the best time to make such decisions, unless it is absolutely necessary.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. While testing the plan may drive some changes in roles based on test results; roles (including who declares the disaster) should have been established before testing and plan approval.
texts.text: While testing the plan may drive some changes in roles based on test results; roles (including who declares the disaster) should have been established before testing and plan approval.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Roles and responsibilities for all involved in incident response should be established when the incident response plan is established, not after the details have been approved.
texts.text: Roles and responsibilities for all involved in incident response should be established when the incident response plan is established, not after the details have been approved.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 90. An information security manager is in the process of investigating a network intrusion. One of the enterprise's employees is a suspect. The manager has just obtained the suspect's computer and hard drive. Which of the following is the BEST next step?
texts.text: An information security manager is in the process of investigating a network intrusion. One of the enterprise's employees is a suspect. The manager has just obtained the suspect's computer and hard drive. Which of the following is the BEST next step?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Create an image of the hard drive.
texts.text: Create an image of the hard drive.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Encrypt the data on the hard drive.
texts.text: Encrypt the data on the hard drive.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Examine the original hard drive.
texts.text: Examine the original hard drive.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Create a logical copy of the hard drive.
texts.text: Create a logical copy of the hard drive.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. One of the first steps in an investigation is to create an image of the original hard drive. A physical copy will copy the data, block by block, including any hidden data blocks and hidden partitions that can be used to conceal evidence.
texts.text: One of the first steps in an investigation is to create an image of the original hard drive. A physical copy will copy the data, block by block, including any hidden data blocks and hidden partitions that can be used to conceal evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Encryption is not required.
texts.text: Encryption is not required.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A logical copy will only copy the files and folders and may not copy other necessary data to properly examine the hard drive for forensic evidence.
texts.text: A logical copy will only copy the files and folders and may not copy other necessary data to properly examine the hard drive for forensic evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Examining the hard drive is not good practice because it risks destroying or corrupting evidence.
texts.text: Examining the hard drive is not good practice because it risks destroying or corrupting evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 91. The factor that is MOST likely to result in identification of security incidents is:
texts.text: The factor that is MOST likely to result in identification of security incidents is:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. effective communication and reporting processes.
texts.text: effective communication and reporting processes.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. clear policies detailing incident severity levels.
texts.text: clear policies detailing incident severity levels.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. intrusion detection system capabilities.
texts.text: intrusion detection system capabilities.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. security awareness training.
texts.text: security awareness training.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Timely communication and reporting is only useful after identification of an incident has occurred.
texts.text: Timely communication and reporting is only useful after identification of an incident has occurred.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Intrusion detection systems are useful for detecting IT-related incidents but are not useful for identifying other types of incidents such as social engineering or physical intrusion.
texts.text: Intrusion detection systems are useful for detecting IT-related incidents but are not useful for identifying other types of incidents such as social engineering or physical intrusion.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Understanding how to establish severity levels is important, but it is not the essential element for ensuring that the information security manager is aware of anomalous events that might signal an incident.
texts.text: Understanding how to establish severity levels is important, but it is not the essential element for ensuring that the information security manager is aware of anomalous events that might signal an incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Ensuring that employees have the knowledge to recognize and report a suspected incident is most likely to result in identification of security incidents.
texts.text: Ensuring that employees have the knowledge to recognize and report a suspected incident is most likely to result in identification of security incidents.

texts.orig: 92. Which of the following functions is responsible for determining the members of the enterprise's response teams?
texts.text: Which of the following functions is responsible for determining the members of the enterprise's response teams?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Governance
texts.text: Governance

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Risk management
texts.text: Risk management

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Compliance
texts.text: Compliance

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Information security
texts.text: Information security

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The governance function will determine the strategy and policies that will set the scope and charter for incident management and response capabilities.
texts.text: The governance function will determine the strategy and policies that will set the scope and charter for incident management and response capabilities.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. While response is a component of managing risk, the basis for risk management is determined by governance and strategy requirements.
texts.text: While response is a component of managing risk, the basis for risk management is determined by governance and strategy requirements.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Compliance would not be directly related to this activity, although this function may have representation on the incident response team.
texts.text: Compliance would not be directly related to this activity, although this function may have representation on the incident response team.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The information security manager, or designated manager for incident response, should select the team members to ensure that all required disciplines are represented on the team.
texts.text: The information security manager, or designated manager for incident response, should select the team members to ensure that all required disciplines are represented on the team.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 93. The typical requirement for security incidents to be resolved quickly and service restored is:
texts.text: The typical requirement for security incidents to be resolved quickly and service restored is:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. always the best option for an enterprise.
texts.text: always the best option for an enterprise.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. often in conflict with effective problem management.
texts.text: often in conflict with effective problem management.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. the basis for enterprise risk management activities.
texts.text: the basis for enterprise risk management activities.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. a component of forensics training.
texts.text: a component of forensics training.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Quickly restoring service, will not always be the best option, such as in cases of criminal activity, which require preservation of evidence precluding use of the systems involved.
texts.text: Quickly restoring service, will not always be the best option, such as in cases of criminal activity, which require preservation of evidence precluding use of the systems involved.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Problem management is focused on investigating and uncovering the root cause of incidents, which will often be a problem when restoring service compromises the evidence needed.
texts.text: Problem management is focused on investigating and uncovering the root cause of incidents, which will often be a problem when restoring service compromises the evidence needed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Managing risk goes beyond the quick restoration of services (e.g., if doing so would increase some other risk disproportionately).
texts.text: Managing risk goes beyond the quick restoration of services (e.g., if doing so would increase some other risk disproportionately).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Forensics is concerned with legally adequate collection and preservation of evidence, not with service continuity.
texts.text: Forensics is concerned with legally adequate collection and preservation of evidence, not with service continuity.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 94. Which of the following should be the FIRST action to take when a fire spreads throughout the building?
texts.text: Which of the following should be the FIRST action to take when a fire spreads throughout the building?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Check the facility access logs.
texts.text: Check the facility access logs.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Call together the crisis management team.
texts.text: Call together the crisis management team.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Launch the disaster recovery plan.
texts.text: Launch the disaster recovery plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Launch the business continuity plan.
texts.text: Launch the business continuity plan.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer,
texts.text: A is the correct answer,

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification;
texts.text: Justification;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Safety of people always comes first; therefore, verifying access logs of personnel to the facility should be the first action in order to ensure that all staff can be accounted for.
texts.text: Safety of people always comes first; therefore, verifying access logs of personnel to the facility should be the first action in order to ensure that all staff can be accounted for.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Calling the crisis management team together should be done after the initial emergency response (i.e., evacuation of people).
texts.text: Calling the crisis management team together should be done after the initial emergency response (i.e., evacuation of people).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Launching the disaster recovery plan is not the first action.
texts.text: Launching the disaster recovery plan is not the first action.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Launching the business continuity plan is not the first action.
texts.text: Launching the business continuity plan is not the first action.

texts.orig: 95. Which of the following tests gives the MOST assurance that a business continuity plan works, without potentially impacting business operations?
texts.text: Which of the following tests gives the MOST assurance that a business continuity plan works, without potentially impacting business operations?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Checklist tests
texts.text: Checklist tests

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Simulation tests
texts.text: Simulation tests

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Walk-through tests
texts.text: Walk-through tests

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Full operational tests
texts.text: Full operational tests

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. With-checklist tests, copies of the business continuity plan are distributed to various persons for review. In these tests, people do not exercise a plan.
texts.text: With-checklist tests, copies of the business continuity plan are distributed to various persons for review. In these tests, people do not exercise a plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Business continuity coordinators come together to practice executing a plan based on a specific scenario. This does not interrupt normal operations and provides the most assurance of the given nonintrusive methods.
texts.text: Business continuity coordinators come together to practice executing a plan based on a specific scenario. This does not interrupt normal operations and provides the most assurance of the given nonintrusive methods.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. In walk-through tests, representatives come together to go over the plan (one or more scenarios) and ensure the plan's accuracy. The plan itself is not executed.
texts.text: In walk-through tests, representatives come together to go over the plan (one or more scenarios) and ensure the plan's accuracy. The plan itself is not executed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Full operational tests are the most intrusive to regular operations and business productivity. The original site is actually shut down and processing is performed at another site, thus providing the most assurance, but interrupting normal business productivity.
texts.text: Full operational tests are the most intrusive to regular operations and business productivity. The original site is actually shut down and processing is performed at another site, thus providing the most assurance, but interrupting normal business productivity.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 96. An employee's computer has been infected with a new virus. What should be the FIRST action?
texts.text: An employee's computer has been infected with a new virus. What should be the FIRST action?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Execute the virus scan.
texts.text: Execute the virus scan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Report the incident to senior management.
texts.text: Report the incident to senior management.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Format the hard disk.
texts.text: Format the hard disk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Disconnect the computer from the network.
texts.text: Disconnect the computer from the network.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The virus may start infecting other computers while the virus scan is running.
texts.text: The virus may start infecting other computers while the virus scan is running.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A case of virus infection does not warrant the action. Formatting the hard disk is the last resort.
texts.text: A case of virus infection does not warrant the action. Formatting the hard disk is the last resort.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Only when the impact to the IT environment is significant should it be reported to senior management.
texts.text: Only when the impact to the IT environment is significant should it be reported to senior management.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The first action should be to contain the risk (i.e., by disconnecting the computer so that it will not infect other computers on the network).
texts.text: The first action should be to contain the risk (i.e., by disconnecting the computer so that it will not infect other computers on the network).

texts.text: ensure adequate corrective actions were implemented.

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: evaluate the ability of the security team.

texts.text: Management will not review information security incidents merely to demonstrate management commitment.

texts.orig: 99. The PRIMARY selection criterion for an offsite media storage facility is:
texts.text: The PRIMARY selection criterion for an offsite media storage facility is:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. that the primary and offsite facilities are not subject to the same environmental disasters.
texts.text: that the primary and offsite facilities are not subject to the same environmental disasters.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: that the offsite storage facility is not in close proximity to the primary site.

texts.text: the overall storage and maintenance costs of the offsite facility.

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Recovery of the backups

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: Restoration of the system

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A business impact analysis, which identifies the requirements for availability of critical business processes
texts.text: A business impact analysis, which identifies the requirements for availability of critical business processes

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Adequate distance between the primary site and the alternate site so that the same disaster does not simultaneously impact both sites
texts.text: Adequate distance between the primary site and the alternate site so that the same disaster does not simultaneously impact both sites

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: A benchmarking analysis of similarly situated enterprises in the same geographic region to demonstrate due diligence

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 109. Which of the following activities MUST a financial services enterprise do with regard to a web-based service that is gaining popularity among its customers?
texts.text: Which of the following activities MUST a financial services enterprise do with regard to a web-based service that is gaining popularity among its customers?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Perform annual vulnerability mitigation.
texts.text: Perform annual vulnerability mitigation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Maintain third-party liability insurance.
texts.text: Maintain third-party liability insurance.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Conduct periodic business impact analysis
texts.text: Conduct periodic business impact analysis

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Architect a real-time failover capability.
texts.text: Architect a real-time failover capability.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Vulnerability management is an important part of managing any system, not only a web-based service, but mitigation decisions are made on the basis of risk and are not isolated to an annual activity.
texts.text: Vulnerability management is an important part of managing any system, not only a web-based service, but mitigation decisions are made on the basis of risk and are not isolated to an annual activity.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The decision of whether to carry liability insurance is a business decision made on the basis of quantified risk.
texts.text: The decision of whether to carry liability insurance is a business decision made on the basis of quantified risk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A service that is gaining popularity will increase in value to the enterprise as it grows, leading to corresponding growth in the magnitude of potential loss should the service be interrupted. Periodic business impact analyses (BIAs) quantify this magnitude and ensure that adequate recovery capabilities can be put in place.
texts.text: A service that is gaining popularity will increase in value to the enterprise as it grows, leading to corresponding growth in the magnitude of potential loss should the service be interrupted. Periodic business impact analyses (BIAs) quantify this magnitude and ensure that adequate recovery capabilities can be put in place.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Real-time failover capabilities may be warranted, but the decision to design and deploy such capabilities is a business decision based in large part on an accurate BIA quantifying the magnitude of potential loss should the service be interrupted.
texts.text: Real-time failover capabilities may be warranted, but the decision to design and deploy such capabilities is a business decision based in large part on an accurate BIA quantifying the magnitude of potential loss should the service be interrupted.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: A recovery point objective identifies the maximum acceptable data loss associated with successful recovery. It does not prioritize the order of incident response.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Risk assessment (both qualitative and quantitative) examines sources of threat, associated vulnerability and probability of occurrence. At the point that an incident occurs, the probability aspect of risk is no lont   ne   nod e  n   t e n ve specialized business impact analysis.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 127. For global enterprises, which of the following is MOST essential to the continuity of operations in an emergency situation?
texts.text: For global enterprises, which of the following is MOST essential to the continuity of operations in an emergency situation?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A documented succession plan
texts.text: A documented succession plan

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Distribution of key process documents
texts.text: Distribution of key process documents

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A reciprocal agreement with an alternate site
texts.text: A reciprocal agreement with an alternate site

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Strong senior management leadership
texts.text: Strong senior management leadership

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. During contingency situations, contact with one or more senior managers may be lost. In such cases, a documented succession plan is important as a means of establishing who is empowered to make decisions on behalf of the enterprise. However, if an enterprise experiencing a contingency situation has only a succession plan and no distributed key process documentation, the effectiveness of the empowered decision maker will be limited. A succession plan is, therefore, worthwhile but less important than process documentation.
texts.text: During contingency situations, contact with one or more senior managers may be lost. In such cases, a documented succession plan is important as a means of establishing who is empowered to make decisions on behalf of the enterprise. However, if an enterprise experiencing a contingency situation has only a succession plan and no distributed key process documentation, the effectiveness of the empowered decision maker will be limited. A succession plan is, therefore, worthwhile but less important than process documentation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Many factors come into play during contingency situations, but continuity is possible only when personnel who are able to resume key processes have the knowledge to do so. When key process documentation is distributed to contingency locations, it is available for the use of any staff who report to these locations during contingencies, and so long as that documentation is up to date, it may be used even by those who may not typically be involved in performing those functions.
texts.text: Many factors come into play during contingency situations, but continuity is possible only when personnel who are able to resume key processes have the knowledge to do so. When key process documentation is distributed to contingency locations, it is available for the use of any staff who report to these locations during contingencies, and so long as that documentation is up to date, it may be used even by those who may not typically be involved in performing those functions.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Reciprocal agreements are established when contingency sites are shared among multiple business partners. There are business justifications for establishing these relationships, but having them established is generally not going to ensure continuity of operations.
texts.text: Reciprocal agreements are established when contingency sites are shared among multiple business partners. There are business justifications for establishing these relationships, but having them established is generally not going to ensure continuity of operations.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Strong leadership by senior management drives the preparation that goes into continuity of operations planning before a contingency situation arises. Assuming that this preparation has been adequate, however, the continuity functions should be carried out by enterprise personnel even if leadership during the contingency is interrupted or lacking in strength.
texts.text: Strong leadership by senior management drives the preparation that goes into continuity of operations planning before a contingency situation arises. Assuming that this preparation has been adequate, however, the continuity functions should be carried out by enterprise personnel even if leadership during the contingency is interrupted or lacking in strength.

texts.orig: 130. A security operations center detected an attempted structured query language injection but could not determine if it was successful. Which of the following resources should the information security manager approach to assess the possible impact?
texts.text: A security operations center detected an attempted structured query language injection but could not determine if it was successful. Which of the following resources should the information security manager approach to assess the possible impact?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Application support team
texts.text: Application support team

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Business process owner
texts.text: Business process owner

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Network management team
texts.text: Network management team

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. System administrator
texts.text: System administrator

texts.label: section_header

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Structured query language (SQL) injection is an application-based attack. Because the security operations center has detected an attempt of SQL injection and could not determine if it was successful, the information security manager should approach the application support group that has access to data in order to identify the impact.
texts.text: Structured query language (SQL) injection is an application-based attack. Because the security operations center has detected an attempt of SQL injection and could not determine if it was successful, the information security manager should approach the application support group that has access to data in order to identify the impact.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. The business process owner may help the application support group determine the overall impact, after it has been determined if the attack has been successful.
texts.text: The business process owner may help the application support group determine the overall impact, after it has been determined if the attack has been successful.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Because SQL injection is an application-based attack, the network management team is not the best resource to assess the possible impact.
texts.text: Because SQL injection is an application-based attack, the network management team is not the best resource to assess the possible impact.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The system administrator is not the best resource to assess the possible impact but may assist the application support team and assist with incident response activities, should the attack have been successful.
texts.text: The system administrator is not the best resource to assess the possible impact but may assist the application support team and assist with incident response activities, should the attack have been successful.

texts.text: Which of the following gives the MOST assurance of the effectiveness of an enterprise's disaster recovery plan?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Checklist test
texts.text: Checklist test

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Table-top exercise
texts.text: Table-top exercise

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Full interruption test
texts.text: Full interruption test

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Simulation test
texts.text: Simulation test

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A checklist test does not provide more assurance than a full interruption test. Checklist tests are a preliminary step to a real test. Recovery checklists are distributed to all members of a recovery team to review and ensure that the checklist is current.
texts.text: A checklist test does not provide more assurance than a full interruption test. Checklist tests are a preliminary step to a real test. Recovery checklists are distributed to all members of a recovery team to review and ensure that the checklist is current.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Babt se - t ate  a aat se   e  se -  ay consist of virtual walk-throughs of the disaster recovery plan (DRP), or they may involve virtual walkthroughs of the DRP based on different scenarios.
texts.text: Babt se - t ate  a aat se   e  se -  ay consist of virtual walk-throughs of the disaster recovery plan (DRP), or they may involve virtual walkthroughs of the DRP based on different scenarios.

It generally involves shutting down operations at the primary site and shifting them to the recovery site in accordance with the recovery plan; this is the most rigorous form of testing.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 137. Which of the following is MOST likely to improve the effectiveness of the incident response team?
texts.text: Which of the following is MOST likely to improve the effectiveness of the incident response team?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Briefing team members on the nature of new threats to information systems (IS) security
texts.text: Briefing team members on the nature of new threats to information systems (IS) security

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Ensuring that all members have a good understanding of IS technology
texts.text: Ensuring that all members have a good understanding of IS technology

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Periodic testing and updates to incorporate lessons learned
texts.text: Periodic testing and updates to incorporate lessons learned

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A non-hierarchical structure to ensure that team members can share ideas
texts.text: A non-hierarchical structure to ensure that team members can share ideas

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The fact that threats can materialize into an incident requires the presence of system vulnerabilities. It is the. vulnerabilities that should be the focus of analysis when considering incident management procedures.
texts.text: The fact that threats can materialize into an incident requires the presence of system vulnerabilities. It is the. vulnerabilities that should be the focus of analysis when considering incident management procedures.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Periodic testing and updates to incorporate lessons learned will ensure that implementation of the incident management response plan is aligned and kept current with the business priorities set by business management.
texts.text: Periodic testing and updates to incorporate lessons learned will ensure that implementation of the incident management response plan is aligned and kept current with the business priorities set by business management.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. All members of the incident management response team do not need to have IS skills. Members who take charge of implementing the incident management response plan should be able to use different skills to ensure alignment with the enterprise's procedures and policies.
texts.text: All members of the incident management response team do not need to have IS skills. Members who take charge of implementing the incident management response plan should be able to use different skills to ensure alignment with the enterprise's procedures and policies.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. It is important that someone take ownership of implementing the incident management plan (e.g., to formally declare that such a plan needs to be put into place after an incident). A non-hierarchical structure can introduce ambiguity as to who is responsible for what aspects of the incident management response plan.
texts.text: It is important that someone take ownership of implementing the incident management plan (e.g., to formally declare that such a plan needs to be put into place after an incident). A non-hierarchical structure can introduce ambiguity as to who is responsible for what aspects of the incident management response plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 138. Which of the following is the BEST way to confirm that disaster recovery planning is current?
texts.text: Which of the following is the BEST way to confirm that disaster recovery planning is current?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Audits of the business process changes
texts.text: Audits of the business process changes

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Maintenance of the latest configurations
texts.text: Maintenance of the latest configurations

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Regular testing of the disaster recovery plan
texts.text: Regular testing of the disaster recovery plan

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Maintenance of the personnel contact list
texts.text: Maintenance of the personnel contact list

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Auditing business process changes will not necessarily enable maintenance of the disaster recovery plan (DRP).
texts.text: Auditing business process changes will not necessarily enable maintenance of the disaster recovery plan (DRP).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. When a DRP is properly tested, the results of the tests will reveal shortcomings and opportunities for improvement,
texts.text: When a DRP is properly tested, the results of the tests will reveal shortcomings and opportunities for improvement,

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Maintenance of the latest configuration will not show how current the process is, which is vital for disaster recovery planning.
texts.text: Maintenance of the latest configuration will not show how current the process is, which is vital for disaster recovery planning.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The maintenance of the personnel contact list is an indication of the personnel to be involved in the DRP. Although indicative of how current the DRP is, the DRP also should include the suppliers, customers and vendors needed for its success.
texts.text: The maintenance of the personnel contact list is an indication of the personnel to be involved in the DRP. Although indicative of how current the DRP is, the DRP also should include the suppliers, customers and vendors needed for its success.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 139. Which of the following activities MOST increases the probability that an enterprise will be able to resume operations after a disaster?
texts.text: Which of the following activities MOST increases the probability that an enterprise will be able to resume operations after a disaster?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Restoration testing
texts.text: Restoration testing

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Establishment of a warm site
texts.text: Establishment of a warm site

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Daily data backups
texts.text: Daily data backups

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. An incident response plan
texts.text: An incident response plan

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A demonstrated ability to restore data is the best way to ensure that data can be restored after a disaster, and data drive the majority of business processes. If an enterprise is unable to restore its data, it will be of little value to have other considerations in place. On the other hand, if data can be restored, the enterprise can likely find workarounds for other challenges that it may face.
texts.text: A demonstrated ability to restore data is the best way to ensure that data can be restored after a disaster, and data drive the majority of business processes. If an enterprise is unable to restore its data, it will be of little value to have other considerations in place. On the other hand, if data can be restored, the enterprise can likely find workarounds for other challenges that it may face.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Having a warm site speeds up the process of disaster recovery by providing the facilities and equipment where data can be restored and operations reconstituted. However, if the data themselves cannot be restored, having the facilities and equipment will not be nearly as useful.
texts.text: Having a warm site speeds up the process of disaster recovery by providing the facilities and equipment where data can be restored and operations reconstituted. However, if the data themselves cannot be restored, having the facilities and equipment will not be nearly as useful.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Performing data backups on a daily or other periodic basis is a good practice, but it is not until recovery is attempted that an enterprise gains knowledge of whether these backups are effective. Should the enterprise diligently perform backups for months or years and then discover that it cannot restore the data, all the time and expense of the backup program will have been wasted.
texts.text: Performing data backups on a daily or other periodic basis is a good practice, but it is not until recovery is attempted that an enterprise gains knowledge of whether these backups are effective. Should the enterprise diligently perform backups for months or years and then discover that it cannot restore the data, all the time and expense of the backup program will have been wasted.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Recovery procedures are documented in the disaster recovery plan rather than in the incident response plan.
texts.text: Recovery procedures are documented in the disaster recovery plan rather than in the incident response plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 140. Which of the following BEST contributes to the design of data restoration plans?
texts.text: Which of the following BEST contributes to the design of data restoration plans?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Transaction turnaround time
texts.text: Transaction turnaround time

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Mean time between failures
texts.text: Mean time between failures

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Service delivery objectives
texts.text: Service delivery objectives

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The duration of the data restoration job
texts.text: The duration of the data restoration job

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: C is the correct answer.
texts.text: C is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Transaction turnaround time may be a concern when the effectiveness of an application system is evaluated. Normally it is not the main agenda in the restoration stage.
texts.text: Transaction turnaround time may be a concern when the effectiveness of an application system is evaluated. Normally it is not the main agenda in the restoration stage.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Mean time between failures (MTBF) is the predicted elapsed time between inherent failures of a system during operation. MTBF is not a factor in determining restoration of data.
texts.text: Mean time between failures (MTBF) is the predicted elapsed time between inherent failures of a system during operation. MTBF is not a factor in determining restoration of data.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The service delivery objective (SDO) relates directly to the business needs; SDO is the level of services to be reached during the alternate process mode until the normal situation is restored.
texts.text: The service delivery objective (SDO) relates directly to the business needs; SDO is the level of services to be reached during the alternate process mode until the normal situation is restored.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The duration of a data restoration job may be of secondary importance. The strategic importance of data should be considered first.
texts.text: The duration of a data restoration job may be of secondary importance. The strategic importance of data should be considered first.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 141. Which of the following contributes MOST to incident response team efficiency?
texts.text: Which of the following contributes MOST to incident response team efficiency?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Security policies and procedures
texts.text: Security policies and procedures

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Defined roles and responsibilities
texts.text: Defined roles and responsibilities

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Digital forensic analysis skills
texts.text: Digital forensic analysis skills

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Reporting line structure
texts.text: Reporting line structure

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Knowing about security policies and procedures may be important. However, this knowledge is not a must item for an incident response team to work efficiently.
texts.text: Knowing about security policies and procedures may be important. However, this knowledge is not a must item for an incident response team to work efficiently.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Incident response team members need to work in a disrupted environment; therefore, it is essential that they be clearly aware of roles and responsibility prior to engagement.
texts.text: Incident response team members need to work in a disrupted environment; therefore, it is essential that they be clearly aware of roles and responsibility prior to engagement.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. There could be an instance when a digital forensic analyst is needed. In such a case, assigning a qualified professional may be the best solution, rather than having the response team learn the skills.
texts.text: There could be an instance when a digital forensic analyst is needed. In such a case, assigning a qualified professional may be the best solution, rather than having the response team learn the skills.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. The reporting structure is a mandatory component for a team to operate. However, in the case of incident response, team size is usually small and the reporting line may be flat. Thus, it may not be a major contributor to efficiency.
texts.text: The reporting structure is a mandatory component for a team to operate. However, in the case of incident response, team size is usually small and the reporting line may be flat. Thus, it may not be a major contributor to efficiency.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 142. Which of the following needs to be MOST seriously considered when designing a risk-based incident response management program?
texts.text: Which of the following needs to be MOST seriously considered when designing a risk-based incident response management program?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. The chance of collusion among staff
texts.text: The chance of collusion among staff

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Degradation of investigation quality
texts.text: Degradation of investigation quality

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Minimization of false-positive alerts
texts.text: Minimization of false-positive alerts

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Monitoring repeated low-risk events
texts.text: Monitoring repeated low-risk events

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A u l l s  a   c    t   a  n number of staff, it is hard to detect. However, successful collusion is not common.
texts.text: A u l l s  a   c    t   a  n number of staff, it is hard to detect. However, successful collusion is not common.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. As long as it is well-defined, it is unlikely that the quality of incident investigation will fall short.
texts.text: As long as it is well-defined, it is unlikely that the quality of incident investigation will fall short.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. A risk-based approach may not guarantee the minimization of false-positive alerts.
texts.text: A risk-based approach may not guarantee the minimization of false-positive alerts.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A risk-based approach focuses on high-risk items. Those attempting to commit fraud may take advantage of its weaknesses. When risk-based monitoring is in place, there is a higher chance of overlooking low-risk activities. Even though the impact of a low-risk event is small, it may not be possible to ignore the accumulated damage from its repeated occurrence. Therefore, it is essential to review the chance of the repeated occurrence of low-risk events.
texts.text: A risk-based approach focuses on high-risk items. Those attempting to commit fraud may take advantage of its weaknesses. When risk-based monitoring is in place, there is a higher chance of overlooking low-risk activities. Even though the impact of a low-risk event is small, it may not be possible to ignore the accumulated damage from its repeated occurrence. texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 143. What is the MOST appropriate IT incident response management approach for an enterprise that has outsourced its IT and incident management function?
texts.text: What is the MOST appropriate IT incident response management approach for an enterprise that has outsourced its IT and incident management function?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. A tested plan and a team to provide oversight
texts.text: A tested plan and a team to provide oversight

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. An individual to serve as the liaison between the parties
texts.text: An individual to serve as the liaison between the parties

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Clear notification and reporting channels
texts.text: Clear notification and reporting channels

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A periodic audit of the provider's capabilities
texts.text: A periodic audit of the provider's capabilities

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. An approved and tested plan will provide assurance of the provider's ability to address incidents within an acceptable recovery time, and an internal team's ability to provide oversight and liaison functions that ensure the response is executed according to plan.
texts.text: An approved and tested plan will provide assurance of the provider's ability to address incidents within an acceptable recovery time, and an internal team's ability to provide oversight and liaison functions that ensure the response is executed according to plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Identifying a liaison is not sufficient by itself to provide assurance of adequate incident response performance.
texts.text: Identifying a liaison is not sufficient by itself to provide assurance of adequate incident response performance.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Notification and reporting is not a sufficient assurance of suitable response activities and provides no capability for input, participation or addressing related issues in a timely manner.
texts.text: Notification and reporting is not a sufficient assurance of suitable response activities and provides no capability for input, participation or addressing related issues in a timely manner.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Audits provide a periodic snapshot of the sufficiency of the provider's plans and capabilities but are not adequate to manage collateral and consequential issues in the event of a significant incident.
texts.text: Audits provide a periodic snapshot of the sufficiency of the provider's plans and capabilities but are not adequate to manage collateral and consequential issues in the event of a significant incident.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 144. Which of the following choices is MOST important to ensure the admissibility of forensic evidence?
texts.text: Which of the following choices is MOST important to ensure the admissibility of forensic evidence?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Adequacy of the retention period
texts.text: Adequacy of the retention period

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Storage on read-only media
texts.text: Storage on read-only media

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Review by an independent authority
texts.text: Review by an independent authority

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Traceability of control
texts.text: Traceability of control

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: D is the correct answer.
texts.text: D is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. While evidence must necessarily be retained long enough to be submitted, the length of the retention period does not itself affect the admissibility of evidence.
texts.text: While evidence must necessarily be retained long enough to be submitted, the length of the retention period does not itself affect the admissibility of evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Read-only media reduces the possibility of tampering as a technical capability, but maintenance of a chain of custody serves as an adequate safeguard in any case.
texts.text: Read-only media reduces the possibility of tampering as a technical capability, but maintenance of a chain of custody serves as an adequate safeguard in any case.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Review by an independent authority does not guarantee admissibility.
texts.text: Review by an independent authority does not guarantee admissibility.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Evidence is inadmissible without a clear chain of custody, which is a tracing of who had control of the evidence throughout the process.
texts.text: Evidence is inadmissible without a clear chain of custody, which is a tracing of who had control of the evidence throughout the process.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 145. What action should an incident response team take if the investigation of an incident response event cannot be completed in the time allocated?
texts.text: What action should an incident response team take if the investigation of an incident response event cannot be completed in the time allocated?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Continue to work the current action.
texts.text: Continue to work the current action.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Escalate to the next level for resolution.
texts.text: Escalate to the next level for resolution.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Skip to the next action in the plan.
texts.text: Skip to the next action in the plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Declare a disaster.
texts.text: Declare a disaster.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B is the correct answer.
texts.text: B is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Every unsuccessful action simply wastes time; escalate and move on.
texts.text: Every unsuccessful action simply wastes time; escalate and move on.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Because the investigation process must have time constraints, if the initial team cannot find resolution in the plan time allotted, it should escalate the resolution to the next level and move on to system recovery.
texts.text: Because the investigation process must have time constraints, if the initial team cannot find resolution in the plan time allotted, it should escalate the resolution to the next level and move on to system recovery.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. The activity in an incident response event should not stop until the root cause has been determined, but other teams may need to. be called in to divide the work and complete the response plan.
texts.text: The activity in an incident response event should not stop until the root cause has been determined, but other teams may need to. be called in to divide the work and complete the response plan.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. A disaster should not be declared until the event root cause has been determined or senior management has determined that the resolution will take longer than acceptable for a system outage.
texts.text: A disaster should not be declared until the event root cause has been determined or senior management has determined that the resolution will take longer than acceptable for a system outage.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 146. Which of the following choices is a characteristic of security information and event management (SIEM) technology?
texts.text: Which of the following choices is a characteristic of security information and event management (SIEM) technology?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. SIEM promotes compliance with security policies.
texts.text: SIEM promotes compliance with security policies.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. SIEM is primarily a means of managing residual risk.
texts.text: SIEM is primarily a means of managing residual risk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. SIEM replaces the need to install a firewall.
texts.text: SIEM replaces the need to install a firewall.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. SIEM provides a full range of compensating controls.
texts.text: SIEM provides a full range of compensating controls.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: A is the correct answer.
texts.text: A is the correct answer.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. If properly deployed, configured and tuned, security information and event management (SIEM) can provide information on policy compliance, incident monitoring and other capabilities.
texts.text: If properly deployed, configured and tuned, security information and event management (SIEM) can provide information on policy compliance, incident monitoring and other capabilities.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. SIEM is an automated review of logs through aggregation and correlation and does not replace the need for firewalls.
texts.text: SIEM is an automated review of logs through aggregation and correlation and does not replace the need for firewalls.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. SIEM is not used to manage residual risk.
texts.text: SIEM is not used to manage residual risk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. SIEM provides a series of detective controls, not compensating controls.
texts.text: SIEM provides a series of detective controls, not compensating controls.

texts.orig: 150. In following up on a security incident, the system administrator is to copy data from one hard disk to another. From a forensic perspective, which of the following tasks must be ensured?
texts.text: In following up on a security incident, the system administrator is to copy data from one hard disk to another. From a forensic perspective, which of the following tasks must be ensured?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. Copy to the same disk model as the original.
texts.text: Copy to the same disk model as the original.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. Make a dual backup of the original disk.
texts.text: Make a dual backup of the original disk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Keep the digital hash from both hard disks.
texts.text: Keep the digital hash from both hard disks.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: D. Perform a restoration test after replication.
texts.text: Perform a restoration test after replication.

texts.label: section_header

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Justification:
texts.text: Justification:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: A. For a copy, the target hard disk does not require the same specification as the original disk; therefore, this is not the best choice.
texts.text: For a copy, the target hard disk does not require the same specification as the original disk; therefore, this is not the best choice.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: B. It is a good practice to make a dual backup; however, it does not prove that data are not modified by anyone.
texts.text: It is a good practice to make a dual backup; however, it does not prove that data are not modified by anyone.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. In order to prove that data are not modified before and after the copy is made, it is best to keep a digital hash from both hard disks. The hashes alone are not adequate to meet the standards of evidence admissibility, but they will support other aspects of integrity in the context of data forensics.

texts.orig: D. It is a good practice to perform a restoration test. This is to ensure availability rather than to maintain evidential capability.
